title: Engineering Team Lead, Serverless Containers
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

This is a people-leadership role from day one. You will manage the team — hiring, coaching, performance, growth paths, honest feedback — while staying close to the code: roughly half your time in architecture decisions and the hardest technical problems the team faces, the other half leading your squad. If you are looking for a senior IC role, this is not it.

You will lead the team building our serverless containers product: the way developers run AI apps, MCP servers, APIs, and managed workers on our cloud without thinking about servers. Push a container, get an endpoint, scale from zero to thousands of instances and back down — across CPU and GPU.

On a hyperscaler, the serverless layer is a product someone else built. Here you own it end to end: the scheduler that decides where a container lands, the routing path a request takes, the machinery that turns a scaled-to-zero service into a warm instance before a customer notices. All of it runs on metal, network, and datacenters we own.

title: SRE / Platform Engineer (all genders) - Remote Germany
description:
About Linro

Linro is a Berlin-based cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro.

Infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making the changes. Tools that scan snapshots and flag risk after the fact can't keep up. Linro enforces intended state across the whole lifecycle instead, from commit to runtime: MCP and pre-commit hooks at commit time, blast-radius simulation that blocks bad changes before they ship, and real-time detection, enforcement and auto-remediation in production. Most tools tell you what's wrong. Linro stops it.

We have each been on the receiving end of this problem: Running cloud security at scale, building the platforms underneath it, and shipping in regulated systems where a wrong change isn't an option. Founded in Berlin in 2026 and built fully remote across Europe, Linro has a platform that's real and working, with plenty still to shape.

The role

You would be one of our first infrastructure hires, taking day-to-day operation of the platform off the CTO. Linro enforces policy on other people's cloud infrastructure, so our own has to be reliable, reproducible and auditable. You own production: how Linro runs for each customer, how it upgrades, and how we know it is unhealthy before a customer does.

What you will do

  • Own production reliability: SLOs, alerting, on-call and blameless postmortems for the control plane and every customer installation.

  • Make the install fleet boring: provisioning, maintenance windows and safe auto-upgrades across SaaS and self-hosted installs.

  • Fix the open reliability work: sensor memory ceilings and OOM visibility, ClickHouse cost and capacity, and the health of Postgres, PGMQ and Temporal.

  • Evolve the platform: Terraform and Terragrunt, Helm, GitHub Actions with short-lived OIDC credentials, local development (Tilt, Coder), and staging and production environments, with guardrails for humans and AI agents alike.

  • Produce audit-ready operations: backups, disaster recovery and continuity tests with evidence for SOC 2 and ISO 27001.

What we are looking for

  • Hands-on operation of AWS, GCP or Azure in production, AWS preferred. Not just deploying to it, actually running it: accounts and access management, networking and the failure modes. We run across several clouds, so you pick up the others quickly.

  • 3+

description:
Als IT-Dienstleister treiben wir die Digitalisierung des öffentlichen Sektors voran und schaffen echten Mehrwert für Millionen Menschen in Deutschland. Wir können vieles richtig gut, aber eben noch nicht alles. Darum suchen wir immer wieder neue Kolleg:innen, die mit ihren Ideen, ihrem Können und Engagement etwas bewegen wollen. Fühlst du dich angesprochen? Dann gestalte Deine Welt zum Besseren und werde Teil unseres Customer Clusters Healthcare.

DEINE MISSION

Als Senior IT Architect (m/w/d) gestaltest du die technische Zukunft unserer Healthcare-Lösungen. Du analysierst komplexe Anforderungen im Umfeld der gesetzlichen Krankenversicherung und entwickelst daraus sichere, skalierbare und nachhaltige IT-Architekturen. Dabei übernimmst du die fachliche und technische Verantwortung für Architekturentscheidungen und begleitest deren Umsetzung gemeinsam mit Entwicklungsteams und Stakeholdern.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung und technische Konzeption moderner Lösungsarchitekturen im GKV-Umfeld

  • Verantwortung für Architekturentscheidungen sowie Definition von Architekturstandards und technischen Leitplanken

  • Analyse fachlicher und technischer Anforderungen und Überführung in zukunftsfähige Lösungsdesigns

  • Sicherstellung von IT-Sicherheit, Datenschutz und Compliance-Anforderungen im Healthcare-Umfeld

  • Beratung von Projektteams und Stakeholdern in technischen Fragestellungen

  • Begleitung der technischen Umsetzung sowie Unterstützung bei komplexen Architekturthemen

  • Bewertung und Einführung geeigneter Technologien, Frameworks und Architekturansätze

  • Identifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen in bestehenden Systemlandschaften

  • Bewertung und Einsatz innovativer Technologien wie KI zur Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Lösungen

DAS IST UNS WICHTIG

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse moderner Softwarearchitekturen sowie Erfahrung mit Java-/JEE-basierten Enterprise-Anwendungen

  • Erfahrung in der technischen Konzeption komplexer Anwendungssysteme sowie mit Integrations- und Schnittstellenarchitekturen, z. B. REST oder SOAP

  • Erfahrung mit Cloud- und Container-Technologien wie Kubernetes, OpenShift oder Docker

  • Fundierte Erfahrung im Umfeld der gesetzlichen Krankenversicherung (GKV) und ein gutes Verständnis für die Anforderungen des Gesundheitswesens

  • Kenntnisse im Umgang mit sensiblen Daten sowie regulatorischen Anforderungen in einem entsprechend geschützten Umfeld

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (C2-Niveau)

title: Infrastructure Engineer (ML Systems) - Paris
description:
You’ll own the GPU compute that powers our model training, evaluation and serving systems.

This role sits in our Infrastructure team, which works at the lowest layers of our stack, from Kubernetes down to the GPU hardware. You’ll run the clusters, GPUs and schedulers that our research, product and platform teams depend on, and manage the capacity we buy from our cloud providers.

What success looks like

Success is measured by how well we use our GPUs: keeping production reliable and improving the performance of our training and serving stack.

What you’ll be doing

  • Running Kubernetes clusters for GPU training and inference

  • Improving how GPU work is scheduled and placed

  • Detecting, draining and repairing unhealthy GPU nodes

  • Managing capacity with our cloud providers

  • Debugging failures in GPUs, Linux, storage and networking

The first year

By month 3, you’ll be handling a share of cluster incidents on your own and will have shipped one change to scheduling or node health, such as automatically detecting and draining unhealthy GPU nodes. By month 6, you’ll own one part of the compute layer outright: scheduling and placement, node health and repair, or capacity and new regions. By month 12, you’ll be responsible for a globally distributed GPU system that shifts capacity between training and inference as needs change.

Who you’ll work with

Your hiring manager is our VP of Engineering. Day to day, you’ll work with the Platform Infrastructure team, the research and product teams who use our compute, and our cloud providers and other vendors.

What we think it takes

You’re likely a good fit if you:

  • Have built and run GPU workloads on Kubernetes

  • Could design a GPU cluster for training and online RL from scratch

  • Debug confidently at the OS layer and below (Linux, GPU drivers, networking and storage)

  • Write strong Python

It’s a plus if you’ve worked as an SRE or infrastructure engineer, or have used:

  • Slurm

  • Kubernetes scheduling and autoscaling tools such as Kueue or Karpenter

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Java) — IoT Remote Monitoring & Energy Management System
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (Java) — IoT Remote Monitoring & Energy Management System

Location: Germany · Munich
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Team

We are building an IoT remote monitoring and Energy Management System (EMS) for the European market, covering data ingestion, monitoring & alerting, and energy scheduling/optimization for PV and storage assets. Our stack is modern, our market is Europe (GDPR, Data Act compliance), and we are exploring AI-powered assistants as a new direction. You will take deep ownership of core system design and evolution, with a clear growth path toward System Engineering (solution design) or full-stack development.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop backend services for IoT remote monitoring and EMS: device data ingestion, time-series processing, alerting, reporting, and control-command flows.

  • Build, test, and ship modules on our stack: Java 21 / Spring Boot / MyBatis-Plus / MySQL / Redis / Kafka / ClickHouse / Quartz / S3-MinIO.

  • Own system-solution work: analyze requirements, produce database designs, API designs, and third-party integration proposals; lead or join technical design reviews.

  • Integrate with third-party systems and data exchanges (REST / SFTP / object storage) with security and reliability.

  • Support production operations: monitoring & alerting, performance optimization, troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.

  • Collaborate with product, frontend, and compliance teams to embed GDPR / Data Act requirements into system design.

  • Explore and deliver AI-powered features (e.g., AI Q&A assistant).

Requirements (Must-have)

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science or related field; 6+ years of Java backend development experience.

  • Strong command of Java / Spring Boot; solid experience designing and delivering microservice architectures.

  • Proficient with MyBatis-Plus and MySQL/MariaDB; strong SQL tuning and schema design skills.

  • Proficient with Redis (cache architecture, distributed locks, cache-consistency strategies).

  • Familiar with Kafka or equivalent messaging systems (RocketMQ etc.), with a solid grasp of delivery semantics (no loss, no duplication, backlog handling).

  • Hands-on experience with ClickHouse or other analytical engines (Doris / StarRocks / time-series databases).

title: Security Engineer (Hybrid or Remote)
description:
About The Role

We’re looking for a Security Engineer to own and improve the security of our internal environment — the identities, SaaS apps, endpoints, AI tooling, and networks our employees use every day. This is a hands-on senior role: we expect you to design controls, find the gaps, and drive the changes that close them — and to build the automation that makes it scale.

We’re an EMI-licensed fintech in a fully cloud-native AWS environment, we use AI heavily, and we’re growing fast. We need someone who can lead technical initiatives independently, influence our security architecture, challenge approaches that no longer fit, and explain it clearly to engineers and leadership.


Your Mission

Detection & Response (SIEM) — our top priority

  • Own SIEM alerting end-to-end: ship logs from endpoints, IdP, VPN, SaaS, and cloud; write and tune detection rules; cut false positives.
  • Act as first responder for security incidents — investigate, contain, drive to closure with clear runbooks — and feed recurring issues back into preventive controls.
Identity, Access & SaaS
  • Administer the IdP (SSO via SAML/OIDC, MFA, conditional access) and run access recertification end-to-end across IdP, SaaS, AWS, and internal tools — scope, evidence, follow-through on revocations.
  • Hunt down over-permissive and stale access, enforce least privilege and PAM, catch SoD gaps, and make JML and third-party access work in practice.
  • Improve SaaS security posture (Google/Microsoft, Slack, GitHub, others) and apply DLP controls to limit data leakage.
Endpoint, Email & Phishing Defense
  • Keep the endpoint stack healthy and well-tuned — MDM, XDR/AV, device-compliance checks for VPN/ZTNA — and define posture requirements (disk encryption, EDR present, OS version) with automated remediation.
  • Defend against phishing and spoofing — secure email gateway rules, DMARC/SPF/DKIM — and run phishing simulations and security awareness, acting on the results.
Automation & Ownership
  • Build internal tooling and automate repetitive operations — reduce manual work, don't just operate it.
  • Own the roadmap for your areas: identify gaps, lead initiatives independently, and raise the bar rather than just maintain it.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in security operations, corporate/IT security, or endpoint engineering.
  • Strong with a SIEM (Splunk, Elastic, Panther, Sumo Logic) — detection engineering and incident response — plus an identity provider (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace), access recertification, and least-privilege / PAM.
  • Working knowledge of endpoint security (MDM, XDR/EDR/AV) and email / phishing defense.
  • Practical experience securing how a company uses AI internally: shadow AI discovery,

title: Technical Sourcer
description:
Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic.

Read this part first

Somewhere out there is a sourcer who is better than their job title says they are. They hit their numbers at a company that never let them talk to a hiring manager. They found the candidate nobody else found and watched a recruiter take the credit. They have been told to be patient, to wait for the next cycle, to earn it.

We are not going to make you wait.

What we do

We build autonomous aircraft and Legion, the software that flies hundreds of them as one coordinated swarm. Series A, backed by Khosla Ventures, and Coatue. We are hiring software engineers and aircraft engineers at the same time, which is hard, and how fast we hire is one of the few things standing between the current aircraft and the next one.

That is not a motivational line. It is the actual constraint. Recruiting is on the critical path here, and you will be able to see your work in the flight schedule.

The job

You own top of funnel for our software engineering roles: backend, frontend, autonomy, forward deployed. You will be reading GitHub profiles, writing outreach that engineers answer, and building searches that keep producing after the obvious names are gone.

Then the interesting part. Inside your first year you move onto the aircraft side: propulsion, structures, avionics, manufacturing, production. Almost nobody sources both. The people who can are rare enough that it changes what your career looks like from that point forward. We will teach you, and you will be bad at it for a while, and then you will not be.

What you get here that you did not get there

  • Your own reqs, early, with your name on the outcome

  • Hiring managers in the same building, not behind an intake form

  • The freedom to change the message when it is not working, without asking three people first

title: Software Engineer, Robotics
description:
Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

About the Role

Our autonomy software runs on real programs and real hardware today, and we built it to be platform-agnostic from the start. We're now scaling it onto our own aircraft to field the largest drone swarm in the world. We're looking for Software Engineers, Robotics to build and harden the on-vehicle systems that get us there.

You'll work across the stack: vehicle software, sensor and payload integration, planning behaviors, and simulation. This is the work that decides whether capability survives contact with real hardware in the field.

What You'll Do

  • Build and extend components across our autonomy stack: planning behaviors, vehicle software, sensor and payload integration, and simulation.

  • Grow the on-vehicle software platform into a real integration surface for first and third-party sensors, payloads, and software modules, so new capability drops in instead of getting rebuilt each time.

  • Create and validate physically realistic simulations of UxS, and keep sim honest against what we actually see in flight and field test.

  • Prototype electronics and troubleshoot complex mixed hardware-software systems, including the failures that only show up on real vehicles.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field.

  • 3+ years building soft-realtime embedded systems or robotics software.

title: Web Developer (all genders)
description:
Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Web Developer (all genders) to start as soon as possible. We live remote-first within Germany, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations.


What makes a good web developer? Not just that they code beautifully – but that they also know everything is still running at 3 a.m. Here, you work according to the "you build it, you run it" principle: full ownership, a modern tech stack, and AI-assisted development that lets you actively shape the architecture of our website.

That's exactly who we're looking for. Not a developer who hands off their code and then watches what happens to it, but someone who builds it, runs it, and stands behind it. For us, "you build it, you run it" isn't a saying that sounds nice – it's everyday reality:
 you write a feature, test it, push it live, and if something wobbles afterward, you're the one who sets it straight again. Not because no one else is around, but because you know best what you built. No blame game, no ticket disappearing into another team's queue, no "that's not my problem anymore" – real ownership, from the first commit to stable operation in production.

What does that look like in practice? On a typical day, you work on new features for our website, often supported by AI-assisted, agentic coding – not as a gimmick, but as a completely normal tool in your everyday work. You exchange ideas with the team, bring your own thinking to the architecture, and help make decisions rather than just implementing specs. You deploy through continuous delivery, keep an eye on how your code behaves in production, and when something isn't running smoothly, you dig into it yourself instead of waiting for someone else to.

You work with a modern stack (Astro, SvelteKit, TypeScript) and have the freedom to actively shape the architecture of our website – not as a bystander, but as someone whose fingerprints are visible in the end result. title: Platform & Reliability Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Platform & Reliability Engineer (all genders) to start as soon as possible. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich).


As a Platform & Reliability Engineer at Contabo, you take architectural ownership of our shared infrastructure services – the foundation that multiple development teams build on: API gateway and ingress (Kong, Nginx Ingress), persistent storage (Ceph, Longhorn), secrets and identity infrastructure (Vault, Keycloak), edge security and WAF (Cloudflare), and our observability stack. You'll be taking over grown, partially under-documented systems – and that's exactly where the appeal of this role lies: you work your way deep into these systems, identify and remediate known weak points, evaluate aging components with solution-agnostic build-vs-buy reasoning, and decide which legacy pieces get fixed, replaced, or retired.

One of your central mandates: you design and establish an on-call process, including runbooks for platform and infrastructure incidents – where no formal process exists today. In parallel, you mature our observability practices, rolling out distributed tracing, SLOs/SLIs, and meaningful dashboards across the stack, building on our existing tooling with Prometheus, Grafana, Alloy, and OpenTelemetry. In system design reviews, you bring your strong grounding in the fundamentals – load balancing, caching, sharding, replication, consistency trade-offs – and apply them to new and existing services alike.

You won't be managing a team, but you will be the technical authority multiple teams rely on: you advise across teams on shared infrastructure services, document your knowledge consistently, and actively distribute it – so that critical know-how never again depends on a single person. Success in this role means: known risks are resolved, a solid on-call process is up and running, and single points of failure are measurably reduced platform-wide. The position is remote (Germany), with hybrid or on-site work optional; occasional travel for datacenter visits and team offsites is part of the role.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with: 

  • 7+ years of experience in platform, infrastructure, or SRE roles, ideally with end-to-end responsibility for a private cloud or IaaS platform 
  • Hands-on production experience with distributed storage systems (Ceph) and Kubernetes persistent storage (Longhorn or comparable)

What You’ll Work On

  • Low-latency networking across our colocation sites: switching and routing, cross-connects, BGP peering with liquidity providers and clients, and the fabric that carries our trading traffic

  • Bringing new sites to application-ready, starting with Tokyo

  • Our hybrid connectivity into multi-region AWS, including Direct Connect, routing and failover

  • Linux hosts and containers on the critical path, with every change made through code (Ansible, Git, Terraform), never by hand

What We Need

  • 4+ years running production infrastructure in a latency-sensitive environment, such as HFT, an exchange, market data or bank trading infrastructure

title: Security Engineer (Hybrid or Remote)
description:
About The Role

We’re looking for a Security Engineer to own and improve the security of our internal environment — the identities, SaaS apps, endpoints, AI tooling, and networks our employees use every day. This is a hands-on senior role: we expect you to design controls, find the gaps, and drive the changes that close them — and to build the automation that makes it scale.

We’re an EMI-licensed fintech in a fully cloud-native AWS environment, we use AI heavily, and we’re growing fast. We need someone who can lead technical initiatives independently, influence our security architecture, challenge approaches that no longer fit, and explain it clearly to engineers and leadership.


Your Mission

Detection & Response (SIEM) — our top priority

  • Own SIEM alerting end-to-end: ship logs from endpoints, IdP, VPN, SaaS, and cloud; write and tune detection rules; cut false positives.
  • Act as first responder for security incidents — investigate, contain, drive to closure with clear runbooks — and feed recurring issues back into preventive controls.
Identity, Access & SaaS
  • Administer the IdP (SSO via SAML/OIDC, MFA, conditional access) and run access recertification end-to-end across IdP, SaaS, AWS, and internal tools — scope, evidence, follow-through on revocations.
  • Hunt down over-permissive and stale access, enforce least privilege and PAM, catch SoD gaps, and make JML and third-party access work in practice.
  • Improve SaaS security posture (Google/Microsoft, Slack, GitHub, others) and apply DLP controls to limit data leakage.
Endpoint, Email & Phishing Defense
  • Keep the endpoint stack healthy and well-tuned — MDM, XDR/AV, device-compliance checks for VPN/ZTNA — and define posture requirements (disk encryption, EDR present, OS version) with automated remediation.
  • Defend against phishing and spoofing — secure email gateway rules, DMARC/SPF/DKIM — and run phishing simulations and security awareness, acting on the results.
Automation & Ownership
  • Build internal tooling and automate repetitive operations — reduce manual work, don't just operate it.
  • Own the roadmap for your areas: identify gaps, lead initiatives independently, and raise the bar rather than just maintain it.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in security operations, corporate/IT security, or endpoint engineering.
  • Strong with a SIEM (Splunk, Elastic, Panther, Sumo Logic) — detection engineering and incident response — plus an identity provider (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace), access recertification, and least-privilege / PAM.
  • Working knowledge of endpoint security (MDM, XDR/EDR/AV) and email / phishing defense.
  • Practical experience securing how a company uses AI internally: shadow AI discovery,

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Quality to build the agentic layer of how Camunda tests its software.

title: MSP Engineer, Network and Security - Rotating shifts
description:
About BRIXIO

BRIXIO is a cybersecurity and cloud services provider and a Cloudflare Authorised Service Delivery Partner, dual certified in Core Services and Cloudflare One.

We design, implement and operate Cloudflare environments for enterprise and public-sector clients across the Gulf, Europe and Asia, with offices in Casablanca, Paris, Luxembourg, Dubai and Singapore.

Since July 2026, BRIXIO has been part of Equans, a Bouygues group company, combining our specialist focus and technical expertise with the scale, stability and career opportunities of a major international organisation.

The Role

BRIXIO is building a genuine managed services capability — not simply a ticket queue.

As an MSP Engineer, you will operate client Cloudflare environments during your shift, combining reactive incident management with structured, proactive engineering.

You will detect and investigate issues before clients report them, resolve incidents within committed service levels, execute production changes under controlled processes, and carry out proactive activities designed to improve security, performance and service stability over time.

Managed services and support are delivered by the same team. This means your role spans both incident response and scheduled proactive work, with proactive engineering time protected within the rota rather than fitted around ticket volume.

You will be the technical responder on shift, but you will not carry an account alone. Client relationship management and reporting are owned by the Delivery Manager, while technical arbitration sits with the MSP & Support Lead.

There is no expectation to be reachable outside your scheduled shift.

Working Pattern

BRIXIO operates a follow-the-sun model across its teams in Morocco and the Philippines, designed around client demand and defined service coverage windows.

Early Shift

09:00–17:00 Morocco time

Provides full coverage during the core client peak window and is named on relevant client contracts.

Late Shift

15:00–23:00 Morocco time

Extends coverage across the peak window and includes an overlap and structured handover with the Early Shift.

Weekend Rotation

Weekend coverage is shared across the team on a reduced rotation. Sunday forms part of the service window for Gulf clients.

Shifts are managed through a published rota issued in advance, so you will know your schedule ahead of time.

Each shift change includes a 30-minute overlap and written handover, ensuring that engineers do not inherit undocumented situations.

Als Account Executive bei Omnora übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle im operativen B2B SaaS Vertrieb mit Fokus auf Enterprise-Kunden und gehobenen Mittelstand.

Du verantwortest deine eigene Pipeline, führst Deals strukturiert zum Abschluss und baust nachhaltige Kundenbeziehungen auf, immer mit dem Ziel, echten Business Impact bei unseren Kunden zu erzeugen.

Wir sind führender Lösungsanbieter in den Bereichen Energieversorgung, Wasserwirtschaft, Landmanagement, Behörden, Infrastruktur, Facility Management und Telekommunikation. Unsere Produkte helfen Unternehmen, Netze, Anlagen und Prozesse effizient zu planen, zu verwalten und zu optimieren – weltweit im täglichen Einsatz.

Als Cloud Engineer betreiben und entwickeln Sie Azure-basierte Cloud-Infrastrukturen und SaaS-Lösungen für unsere Kunden weiter. Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf Monitoring, Log-Analyse, Störungsbehebung und der Umsetzung von Änderungen im laufenden Betrieb. Sie arbeiten in einem sechsköpfigen Team aus Cloud Engineers und GIS-Consultants und stimmen technische Entscheidungen im CloudOps-Team ab.

Die Aufgaben

SaaS-Lösungen im Betrieb halten

  • Betrieb der neuen SaaS-Lösung in der Azure Landing Zone mit ihrer komplexen Systemarchitektur

  • Überwachung von Azure-Ressourcen und Logs sowie Analyse und Behebung von Störungen im Kundenbetrieb

  • Technische Abstimmung mit Kunden und dem CloudOps-Team bei Betriebsfragen und Fehlern

Änderungen automatisiert umsetzen

  • Deployments und Updates über CI/CD-Pipelines einschließlich anschließender Funktionsprüfung

  • Abbildung von Infrastruktur und Konfiguration mit Infrastructure as Code sowie Automatisierung wiederkehrender Betriebsschritte

  • Dokumentation und Durchführung geplanter Änderungen in den regelmäßigen Wartungsfenstern

Cloud-Umgebungen absichern

  • Umsetzung von Systemhärtung nach CIS-Benchmark und Sicherheitsanforderungen bei neuen Cloud-Lösungen

  • Prüfung und Anpassung von Netzwerk- und Sicherheitskonfigurationen in Azure

  • Konfiguration und Absicherung des externen Zugriffs über Application Gateway und WAF


  • Praktische Erfahrung im Betrieb und in der Weiterentwicklung von Cloud-Infrastrukturen oder SaaS-Lösungen auf Basis von Microsoft Azure

  • Erfahrung mit Infrastructure as Code, vorzugsweise mit Bicep oder vergleichbaren Verfahren

  • Kenntnisse in Netzwerk- und IT-Sicherheit, insbesondere bei der Absicherung von Cloud-Umgebungen

  • Erfahrung mit CI/CD-Pipelines sowie mit Monitoring und Log-Analyse im laufenden Betrieb

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau und gute Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens B2-Niveau

We’ve been growing steadily for over five years, combining the flexibility of a startup with the reliability of an experienced international team.

Tasks

We are looking for a HR Assistant Intern to support our recruiting and candidate consulting activities. You’ll work closely with our recruiters and founders, helping IT specialists find new job opportunities abroad and start careers in Germany.

No prior HR experience is required — you’ll receive onboarding, training, and continuous feedback. This internship is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, enjoys communication, and wants to build a career in HR, recruiting, or international talent consulting.

title: DevOps Team Manager
description:
Bromcom Computers Plc is the UK's fastest-growing cloud-native school Management Information System (MIS) provider, serving thousands of schools across three UK countries. The DevOps Team Manager leads a team of 3-4 engineers and is accountable for the reliable, secure and controlled operation of Bromcom's Azure-first SaaS platform. This is a hands-on DevOps engineering leadership role with an expected balance of 70% hands-on DevOps engineering and 30% people and team management. The manager works closely with the engineers, contributes directly to delivery and operations, and owns completion and ongoing maintenance of the agreed DevOps operational control improvements.

The role requires a credible engineering background. The successful candidate is expected to work directly across Azure platform engineering, CI/CD, Bicep/ARM, automation, incident response and operational controls, while leading the team and setting standards. They must be able to challenge technical decisions, understand operational risk and failure modes, and ensure agreed processes are implemented, followed, evidenced and continually improved. A control is not complete simply because a policy or tool exists; it must work consistently in practice.

Key Responsibilities

People & Team Leadership

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology.

Our products, Street.co.uk and Spectre form a powerful duo, working harmoniously together to transform an agent’s job. From securing more leads and winning new instructions to streamlining business operations and growing market share, our products are supercharging 1,000s of agencies across the UK.

How we work in 2026

Engineering at Street Group has changed. Most of us don't write code by hand day-to-day anymore - agents do; we direct. The bar has moved with it; planning and judgement matter more than typing speed: engineers run several workstreams in parallel, directing agent sessions while their own attention goes on design calls and the more complex problems. Real product and user understanding, once a "nice to have," is now baseline.

Being genuinely tuned into AI tooling is core to the role here, not a side skill - and if you'd rather work the “old” way, that's fair - but we’re probably not the place for you.

You'll own features from start to finish: scoping the problem, directing the build through to deployment, and iterating based on what you learn. You'll also contribute to discovery and ideation, and work alongside designers and engineers to identify, prioritise, and solve problems efficiently. If you love autonomy, are naturally curious, and want to have a genuine impact within a growing company, we think you'd fit right in!

title: Enterprise Account Executive - EMEA
description:
About Abacum

Abacum is the leading Business Planning solution for finance teams to drive performance. By automating reporting, enabling collaboration, and simplifying planning and forecasting, we help finance teams shift from number crunching to driving strategic decisions.

Founded in 2020 by two former CFOs, we’ve grown into a global team of 100+ people across 30+ nationalities. Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Toronto and Barcelona. We’re trusted by industry leaders such as Dish Networks, Strava, BetterUp, Kajabi, JG Wentworth, Abridge, Cortex, and hundreds more.

We have raised over $100m, closing in June 2025 our $60M Series B, led by Scale Venture Partners, with the strong participation of Cathay Innovation, Y Combinator, Atomico, Creandum, and angel operators from Adyen, Zapier, and Twitch.

Our mission is ambitious and we can’t do it alone - join Abacum as we build the future of Business Planning!

We are looking for...

An enterprise seller who already knows the Office of the CFO. You've carried a number selling planning, EPM, FP&A or finance software. You know how a CFO buys, how a steering committee stalls, and how to get a multi-stakeholder deal signed.

At Abacum you'll own a named territory of enterprise and upper mid-market accounts across EMEA. Many of them run legacy planning tools or spreadsheets that can't keep up with the business. Your job is to show them a better foundation, and win.

As an Enterprise Account Executive, you will...

- Own the full sales cycle for a named book of enterprise accounts, from first meeting to signed contract

- Build and run your own pipeline through targeted outbound, events, and partner co-selling with ERP vendors and implementation partners

- Sell to CFOs, VPs of Finance and Heads of FP&A, and bring IT, procurement, security and legal along the way

- Run complex evaluations: discovery, business cases, proofs of concept, and competitive displacements

- Forecast with discipline and keep a clean pipeline in CRM

- Work with Solutions Engineering, Product and Leadership to shape deals, and feed what you hear in the market back into the roadmap

Who we are

Yubo is the Social Discovery app to make new friends and hang out online. By eliminating likes and follows, we empower our users to create genuine connections and show up as their true selves.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow.

Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

It is national security, digital continuity, and economic resilience. Skeleton is the Backbone of Power: equipping AI data centers, electrical grids, defense systems, and critical infrastructure with the resilience to withstand surges, instability, and failure. title: Senior Embedded Linux Engineer
description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation. 


About the role

At Gravis, we build high tech systems that give machine operators super human capabilities. To adapt in real time to changes in the environment the Gravis Rack fuses data from LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, and hydraulics into an autonomous control system. All of it runs on Linux, on compute hardware we design ourselves, bolted to the roof of a machine that vibrates, overheats, and regularly loses network coverage.

As a senior engineer focused on the embedded platform, you will own the software layer closest to that hardware: bootloader, kernel, device tree, root filesystem, and the update mechanism that keeps the fleet current. Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. As our fleet grows and our models become more sophisticated, we need world-class infrastructure to support the full ML lifecycle: from raw sensor data ingestion on the edge to continuous model training, evaluation, and deployment at scale.

title: Manufacturing Quality Engineer
description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. 

Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. 

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. 

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation. 


About the role

We are looking for a manufacturing quality engineer to own the quality and reliability of the Gravis hardware package that turns regular excavators into awesome, autonomous machines. You will work with our engineering and production team in Zurich defining and implementing quality measures like incoming inspections, supply chain validations, failure analysis and product return teardowns to enable our custom AI hardware a safe and reliable operation of heavy machines. You are capable of working both independently and with others, and are intrinsically driven to solve challenging applied problems with a rigorous attention to detail and an exploratory imagination.

You are our first quality hire. There is no dedicated quality team, no lab, and no playbook; you will design the test / fixture / process and then go build it. 


What you will do
  • Define what hardware quality means for Gravis from ground up
  • Design and implement testing systems, jigs and fixtures from incoming inspection to product shipping
  • Document failures, root causes and mitigations, build a failure database and review regularly with design and production
  • Teardown and analysis of field returns, drive corrective actions
  • Own supplier quality: first article inspection, qualification, audits, and 8D follow-through
  • Tighten drawings and specifications; critical characteristics, unambiguous acceptance criteria
  • Help building our long-term reliability and environmental test strategy as we scale

    • What we're looking for
  • A university degree in mechanical, electrical, quality Engineering or equivalent practical experience
  • 3+

Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results.

About the Role

We're looking for a Perception & Sensor Fusion Engineer to develop the algorithms that give the largest drone swarm in the world an accurate, shared picture of the battlespace. This is a deep algorithm role for someone who lives in the details of detection, tracking, and estimation, and wants to see their work fly.

  • Design distributed fusion approaches that combine tracks across the swarm into a single coherent picture.

  • Rigorously characterize algorithm performance against real-world flight data and simulation.

  • Optimize models and estimators for real-time inference on edge compute.

  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.

  • Travel up to 25% of the time for onsite test and integration events.

Basic Qualifications

  • MS or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Math, or related field, or equivalent depth of applied experience.

  • Demonstrated expertise in estimation theory and multi-target tracking (Kalman/particle filters, JPDA, MHT, random finite sets, or similar).

Notabene is planning on going through its first external financial statement audit, covering the fiscal years ending January 2026 and January 2027. You will own that process. You will also own the close, the books, and the accounting policy for a two-entity, multi-currency business whose revenue includes subscription fees, usage-based transaction billing, and a payments network take rate that has no clean accounting precedent anywhere.

The accounting function is already substantially built. Close runs, the books are in order, and readiness work for the audit is well underway. What we need is someone to own it, finish it, and take it through the audit, while raising the standard on policy and documentation as the business gets more complex. You will be the most senior accounting voice in the company, reporting to the VP of Finance, with one direct report and a set of external providers. You will not have a large team before late 2027, and that is deliberate. Capacity here comes from better systems and better automation, and you will be the one deciding what those look like.

Within a year you are successful if

  • Notabene has a clean audit opinion on both fiscal years, with no material weaknesses and no second cycle on auditor requests

  • The close hits its calendar consistently, starting with the revenue close landing on time

  • Revenue recognition is documented in a written memo that stands up in fieldwork, rather than living only in the billing system configuration

  • Multi-entity consolidation and FX translation run cleanly enough to survive audit scrutiny, with intercompany and CTA tied and supported

  • Payroll allocation across departments and software development capitalization are written policy applied consistently, not judgment applied after the fact

About the role

Gauss Fusion is aiming to build the first commercial scale fusion power plant based on the stellarator concept and is seeking an experienced mechanical engineer to lead on development of the robotic maintenance approach.
The fusion environment within the reactor is very aggressive, and in-vessel components such as the breeder blanket and divertor will need to be replaced on a regular basis as the materials become damaged by the radiation. Due to the environment inside the device, and in order to maintain a high overall availability, the maintenance must be done robotically using automated systems to extract and replace the components and bring the removed ones to a hot cell for separation, waste treatment, and recycling.
Gauss Fusion is looking for an innovative mechanical design engineer with experience in robotics to lead the work defining and developing the maintenance approach for the Gauss stellarator power plant and its key stellarator systems. While the magnetic configuration will be designed to maximise access to the reactor, the complex geometry poses a challenge to fixations and kinematics, and inventive approaches to the problem are required.


Main responsibilities

Manage the Gauss Fusion maintenance approach to meet the requirements of a commercial scale fusion power plant design:

  • Develop workable approaches to achieving high power plant availability, taking account of engineering and physics requirements across the reactor.
  • Integrate these remote maintenance requirements into plant layout specifications.
  • Define approaches to minimising hot cell inventory through efficient handling of removed components.
  • Lead development of the breeder blanket and divertor segmentation and fixations resulting from these approaches.
  • Lead development of remote maintenance testing and demonstration systems for the reactor.

description:
Who We Are

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the latest — Privacy Pro. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work — you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role

Working on the Web Dependability Engineering team, you'll make sure websites just work in DuckDuckGo's browsers across Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, helping ensure our users have the best-possible experience browsing with DuckDuckGo. Recent projects include:

  • Reverse-engineering how sites detect our privacy protections and building countermeasures that keep pages working

  • Shimming browser APIs so sites work seamlessly across different browser engines and system webviews

  • Building LLM agent pipelines that automatically reproduce and triage reported site breakage

 

As a Senior Web Compatibility Engineer, you'll be our resident expert on why websites break and how to fix them: owning the webcompat side of our triage process, debugging gnarly issues in code you don't control, distinguishing site bugs from browser bugs from privacy protection-induced breakage, leading the charge when a top site breaks and becomes an incident, shipping

title: Lead Engineer (UK)
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

title: Senior Network Engineer (all genders)
description:
Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Senior Network Engineer to start as soon as possible. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich).


Contabo Group operates one of Europe's largest cloud infrastructure platforms, with data centres across Europe and beyond. As our new Senior Network Engineer, you take on the network backbone that thousands of customers rely on every day, with real ownership from day one.

Right now, the biggest milestone on your plate is the build out of our new AI data centre. You inherit a fully designed Leaf-Spine architecture built on Arista EOS, BGP EVPN, and VXLAN, take ownership of it, refine it where it needs refining, and drive everything from commissioning through to stable production operations. Alongside that, you keep our existing LTG infrastructure running reliably: you design, build, and operate complex network, server, and security systems, analyse and resolve faults, and harden our network security through scrubbers, firewalls, ACLs, and NAC.

Projektentwickler, Bestandshalter, Banken und Makler nutzen syte, um in Sekunden zu entscheiden, ob, was und wo gebaut, saniert oder gekauft wird. Heute bildet unsere Plattform auf Basis von über 300 Terabyte Geodaten digitale Zwillinge für 62 Millionen Gebäude und Grundstücke in Deutschland ab.

Für den nächsten Sprung, von unseren heutigen Gebäudemodellen zum texturierten LoD3-Gebäude, suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Senior Computer Vision / Photogrammetry Engineer (m/w/d) in Münster oder deutschlandweit remote.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Unsere 3D-Modelle verbessern: Du bringst Bilddaten und moderne 3D-Rekonstruktionsverfahren in das Produkt, von Multi-View Stereo bis zu Methoden wie Gaussian Splatting und verbesserst damit unsere Gebäudemodelle erheblich.

  • Mehr aus den Bildern herausholen: Du implementierst Methoden wie Multi-Image Super-Resolution und Occlusion-Aware Reconstruction. So überwindest du begrenzte Bildauflösung und Verdeckungen durch Bäume und andere Objekte.
  • Forschung in die Produktion bringen: Gemeinsam mit unseren Data Engineers, die Pipelines und Plattform verantworten, skalierst du Methoden von einer Handvoll Gebäude auf Millionen.
  • AI-native entwickeln: Du nutzt das volle Potenzial moderner AI-Coding-Tools wie Claude Code und Copilot und identifizierst proaktiv neue KI-Use-Cases im Kontext von Computer Vision und 3D-Rekonstruktion.

description:
About SchemeServe

SchemeServe is insurance software like no other.

Hosted in the cloud for MGAs, brokers and insurers, the SchemeServe platform boasts unique flexibility, unstoppable innovation and truly Obsessive Support.

Started in 2000 by our CEO, Adam, SchemeServe has grown from strength to strength, never having taken outside investment. We're proud of how far we've come and how loyal we've stayed to our Core Values.

We prize self-development and encourage everyone to keep learning and challenging themselves. Free books? Mentoring? Professional development? You got it.

We also offer flexible working, paid charity days, a fantastic, relaxed and open company culture and free biscuits through the post.

We genuinely believe this is the best place you could ever work.

If you're excited, good! So are we.

Come and join the Insurtech revolution!

Principal Backend Engineer

UK Remote

We're looking for an exceptional Principal Backend Engineer to help make backend engineering across SchemeServe better.

You'll be one of the most technically experienced engineers in the organisation and the CTO's primary technical partner for backend engineering, helping shape our architecture, engineering principles and technical direction.

But this isn't primarily a feature delivery role and your job isn't to personally build everything you help design.

Your real job is to make our engineering organisation better at building great software.

You'll work alongside engineers and teams, helping solve difficult problems, challenging their thinking and developing their technical skills and judgement.

What We Mean By Principal

This is a deeply technical role.

You'll need the depth to understand complex backend systems, architecture, security, performance, resilience and maintainability; review designs and implementations; spot risks; and challenge experienced engineers.

But technical knowledge alone isn't enough.

We want someone who understands there isn't always one "correct" way to build software.

Patterns, standards and best practices are useful tools. They aren't commandments.

We care about finding the most appropriate solution to the problem in front of us.

That means understanding the problem, business, existing platform, risks and likely future – and making pragmatic decisions based on the trade-offs.

Sometimes the right answer will be a new service or technology.

Sometimes it'll be improving what we already have.

Sometimes the boring solution really is the best solution.

We're quite comfortable with that.

Project Tricorder — Clinical Infrastructure for Field Operations

We're looking for a hands-on engineer to build two foundations of the Tricorder product: the evaluation harness and training data pipeline behind our AI models, and a clinical knowledge base grounded in tactical combat care, SNOMED CT and ICD-10.

About Project Tricorder - https://www.tricorder-systems.com/

Most healthcare technology assumes a hospital: reliable power, connectivity and a clinician at a desk. Care increasingly happens somewhere else - in the field, in transit, in remote and contested environments, and in the critical minutes before a patient reaches a ward.

Tricorder builds the deployable clinical infrastructure for that world: a rugged, self-contained hardware and software platform that lets clinical teams capture, monitor and act on patient data anywhere, even when the network or the grid can't be relied on. It is a dual-use venture serving defence medical and civilian pre-hospital care.

Our prototype product is already in user testing. Edge AI sits at the core: multimodal language models that turn video, sensor data and clinical notes into patient records, drive predictions and inform data-driven learnings across deployments. To trust those models in the field, we need rigorous data and evaluation - that's where you come in.

What you'll do

You'll own two workstreams, working day to day with the founder and the FF build team.

1. Data pipeline and evaluation harness

Build the data foundations that tell us whether our models are good enough for clinical use.

  • Data labelling: design labelling schemas and guidelines, set up tooling, and run labelling with clinical input, including quality checks and inter-annotator agreement.

  • Data processing: build reproducible pipelines to ingest, clean, de-identify and transform multimodal data (video, sensor streams, text).

  • Video data organisation: structure, version and catalogue video datasets so clips, annotations and metadata stay searchable and traceable.

  • Training dataset preparation: assemble balanced, well-documented train, validation and test splits, with clear lineage from raw data to model input.

description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

This is a remote opportunity for a technically skilled AI professional looking to make a tangible impact across business operations.
You will research, implement, and optimize AI, automation, and data-driven technologies across multiple functions.

You will identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve decision-making, and increase efficiency through technology.

title: Head of Marketing (London or Remote)
description:
About Nebuly

Nebuly is a fast-growing, VC-backed startup building the platform that proves the ROI of enterprise AI.

 

Every enterprise function — sales, customer support, HR, finance — is deploying AI agents at scale, and budgets are following fast. But most companies can't answer a basic question: is this spend actually working?Every enterprise deploying AI agents is asking the same question: is this actually delivering value? Today, almost none of them can answer it. The signal that could answer it is right there — millions of conversations happening every day between employees, customers, and these agents — but it's unstructured, high-volume, and invisible without the right infrastructure. So the ROI question stays unanswered, not because the answer doesn't exist, but because no one can see it. Nebuly makes that signal visible. It sits on top of any enterprise AI deployment, turns those conversations into a clear answer — is this working, and where — and connects the dots back to ROI. Think of it as the accountability layer for enterprise AI: connect once, see the impact, prove the value — with no data ever leaving your environment.

 

Every new data category has created a new software category. CRM turned customer interactions into pipeline accountability. Product analytics turned user behavior into growth accountability. Nebuly is building that same layer for AI — turning millions of invisible conversations into a clear answer on value.

 

Our customers include Oura, CNH Industrial, Vodafone, and Moncler. Demand is accelerating fast, and we're building the team to match.

 

Your Role

As our first Head of Marketing, you will own positioning and pipeline generation for the company - the two things that matter most at this stage. We have ambitious ARR growth targets and are scaling our AE team significantly; marketing needs to contribute pipeline in months, not years.

You will personally own 2-3 core areas - most importantly positioning (working closely with our co-founder to translate the founding vision into something sharp, clear, and externally compelling) and lead generation feeding sales. Everything else - PR, content, events, and so on - you will delegate to the team you build.

This is a builder role: you will start as an individual contributor stitching together the first version of the function, then hire and grow a team of 2-3 people underneath you.

This is not a brand-and-awareness-first role. A

title: Sales Account Executive - Cybersecurity
description:
Passionate about Cybersecurity, open-source or network effect products? Interested in Sales?

Join CrowdSec to build a safer internet for everyone.

What we do

We aim to deter opportunistic and organized cybercrime through an Internet-scale, real-time security network. This network is powered by hundreds of thousands of servers sharing the aggression they block with our open-source software. By coupling this local behavior analysis and sharing its findings within our community, we create a real-time map of IP addresses used by cybercriminals, a large-scale reputation system, and a Crowd-Sourced Cyber Threat Intelligence of unprecedented magnitude that will counter the vast majority of technical hacks.

Who We Are

CrowdSec is a human-sized team of cybersecurity experts. Most of the team has worked remotely since day 1. The CrowdSec solution is used in 180+ countries, it is a well-known, unique, collaborative, open-source security solution that protects hundreds thousands of users. We are animated by a mission: making the Internet a safer place, all together.

Role

As an Account Executive (AE), you will work with the Sales team to help them scale, create new opportunities, interact with them, convert them to Leads, and take the accounts to signature. This will be done in collaboration with the BDRs, presales, Marketing, and Support teams to ensure the most pleasant customer journey.


Must-have

  • A track record of success in selling Cybersecurity software solutions

  • A pre-existing customer/contact base to work on to kickstart your tenure

  • Knowledges of fundamental cybersecurity mechanism

  • Good methodology to deal with inbound leads

  • Good outreach techniques to convert SQLs to clients

  • Experience covering the whole sales process from prospection to signature

  • The ability to build relationships and credibility with both SOC Managers/analysts, DevOps, SecOps, Risk Managers, and C-level Executives alike

  • Predictability and accurate forecasting capabilities

  • Fluency in English and at least a second language; any supplementary languages are considered a plus

Optional

  • You have sold to SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, MSSPs or MSPs

  • Knowledge of the open-software landscape

  • Languages other than English and French are considered a plus

  • Start-up experience

title: (Senior) Performance Marketing (SEA / PPC) Manager (all genders) Augsburg/Hamburg/Remote
description:
Dein Platz in der MAI Group

Als (Senior) Performance Marketing (SEA / PPC) Manager:in gestaltest Du die Zukunft des datengetriebenen Marketings aktiv mit. Mit Deinem strategischen Blick, Deinem Verständnis für Tracking und Deiner Beratungskompetenz begleitest Du komplexe Paid-Media Projekte von der Strategie bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung.

MAI ist eine starke Gruppe mit acht Agenturen verteilt auf die Standorte Hamburg, Berlin, Paderborn, Köln, Augsburg, München, Wien – verbunden durch gemeinsame Ziele, gegenseitigen Austausch und die Zusammenarbeit über Standortgrenzen hinweg. Wo Du auch bei uns startest: Du wirst Teil Deines Teams vor Ort und gleichzeitig Teil von MAI.

Aufgaben

Du betreust und berätst einen eigenen Kundenstamm eigenständig, digtial und persönlich, und verantwortest Strategie und Ergebnis.

  • Du entwickelst Paid-Media-Konzepte, Marktanalysen und Account-Audits über Google Ads und Social Ads hinweg.
  • Du baust Accounts plattformübergreifend und über den gesamten Funnel auf und entwickelst sie weiter: Google (Search, Performance Max, Demand Gen, Shopping) und Meta (Advantage+). Je nach Kunde kommen weitere Plattformen wie Microsoft Advertising, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok oder Pinterest dazu.
  • Du steuerst die Automatisierung der Plattformen gezielt: Smart Bidding, Performance Max und AI Max bei Google, Advantage+ bei Meta, statt manueller Gebots- und Zielgruppenpflege.
  • Du begleitest die Konzeption und Weiterentwicklung von Tracking-Setups und unterstützt unsere Kunden bei Themen wie Consent Mode, Enhanced Conversions und der Meta Conversions API (CAPI), um eine verlässliche Datengrundlage für Optimierungen sicherzustellen.
  • Du präsentierst geplante Maßnahmen und Konzepte gegenüber Kunden und verantwortest sie.
  • Du führst Inhouse-Schulungen bei Kunden durch.
  • Du unterstützt Werkstudent:innen und Trainees fachlich und gibst Dein Wissen weiter.
  • Du nutzt unser internes AI Kit für Analyse, Reporting und Creative-Iteration im Arbeitsalltag.

Qualifikation

Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich SEA/PPC mit, idealerweise rund fünf Jahre, und kannst sichtbare Erfolge in der Betreuung von Accounts vorweisen.

  • Du hast sehr gute Kenntnisse in Google Ads und Microsoft Advertising sowie in Performance Max, Demand Gen und AI Max for Search.
  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Smart Bidding und der Steuerung automatisierter Kampagnen.
  • Du kennst die gängigen Feed- und PPC-Tools wie Google Merchant Center, Channable oder Channelpilot.
  • Du bewegst Dich sicher in Verhandlungen und Präsentationen und trittst kommunikativ stark auf.
  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, verlässlich und zielorientiert und behältst auch bei mehreren Accounts den Überblick.
  • Du denkst kanalübergreifend und verstehst, wie SEA/PPC in eine holistische Online-Marketing-Strategie einzahlt.
  • Du hast sehr gute Kennt

title: Senior Commercial & AI Solutions Partner
description:
Yopeso has been developing a diverse range of software products, from large-scale applications to smaller solutions, for 20 years. With a growing team of over 300 employees across five locations, we are dedicated to fostering a culture of growth, transparency, and professionalism.

At Yopeso, we value authenticity, curiosity, and ambition. These values drive us to build strong connections within our community and with our partners, ensuring trust, integrity, and transparency in all our business practices. We strive to maintain the highest professional standards and continuously challenge ourselves to develop high-quality, high-performance, and secure software solutions.

Our approach is rooted in efficient collaboration among passionate professionals working in agile teams. Guided by curiosity and ambition, we strive to create products that are meaningful and impactful, while remaining true to our authentic selves.


We’re looking for a commercial product-minded partner who can sell, design, and shape AI-first delivery outcomes - someone who thinks like a product leader, sells like a consulting partner, and closes like a top-tier enterprise dealmaker.

This role sits at the intersection of enterprise consulting, product strategy, and AI-enabled delivery transformation. You will originate and close complex engagements where we don’t just sell capacity - we sell outcomes, fixed-price transformations, and AI-accelerated delivery models.

Core Responsibilities

  • Own enterprise deals end to end, from origination to signature

  • Build pipeline with CIOs, CTOs, COOs, and Digital and Product leaders in AI, software delivery and engineering scale-out

  • Turn business problems into productized, AI-augmented offers, shaping what we sell, not only how we deliver it

  • Structure fixed-price, milestone-based and outcome-based deals tied to speed, cost and impact, moving clients away from T&M

  • Advise executives on transformation and operating model redesign

  • Build long-term partnerships across multiple stakeholders on long-cycle, multi-service engagements in Europe and international markets

  • Work with the delivery and engineering leads from the start so what we sell matches what we can deliver

About the role

Gauss Fusion is aiming to build the first commercial scale fusion power plant based on the stellarator concept and is seeking an experienced mechanical engineer to lead on development of the robotic maintenance approach.
The fusion environment within the reactor is very aggressive, and in-vessel components such as the breeder blanket and divertor will need to be replaced on a regular basis as the materials become damaged by the radiation. Due to the environment inside the device, and in order to maintain a high overall availability, the maintenance must be done robotically using automated systems to extract and replace the components and bring the removed ones to a hot cell for separation, waste treatment, and recycling.
Gauss Fusion is looking for an innovative mechanical design engineer with experience in robotics to lead the work defining and developing the maintenance approach for the Gauss stellarator power plant and its key stellarator systems. While the magnetic configuration will be designed to maximise access to the reactor, the complex geometry poses a challenge to fixations and kinematics, and inventive approaches to the problem are required.


Main responsibilities

Manage the Gauss Fusion maintenance approach to meet the requirements of a commercial scale fusion power plant design:

  • Develop workable approaches to achieving high power plant availability, taking account of engineering and physics requirements across the reactor.
  • Integrate these remote maintenance requirements into plant layout specifications.
  • Define approaches to minimising hot cell inventory through efficient handling of removed components.
  • Lead development of the breeder blanket and divertor segmentation and fixations resulting from these approaches.
  • Lead development of remote maintenance testing and demonstration systems for the reactor.


Qualification and educational requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related field, master’s or Ph.D. preferred.
  • Technical experience: 
    • Minimum of 6 years of experience in mechanical engineering, preferably in large-scale engineering projects.

title: Security & Compliance Engineer (all genders) - Remote Germany
description:
About Linro

Linro is a cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro.

Cloud infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making those changes, not people. Most security tools only catch problems after the fact. Linro works differently. We enforce what's allowed at every stage, from commit to production. We stop bad changes before they ship, and fix problems in real time once they're live.

We have each been on the receiving end of this problem: running cloud security at scale, building the platforms underneath it, and shipping in regulated systems where a wrong change isn't an option. Founded in Berlin in 2026 and built fully remote across Europe, Linro has a platform that's real and working, with plenty still to shape.

The role

You will own Linro's security and compliance program end to end, starting from a blank page. Your job is to build that from scratch: figure out where we actually stand, find the gaps, and close them across a multi-cloud environment. Automate what can be automated instead of redoing the same work by hand every quarter.

What you will do

  • Take SOC2, ISO 27001 and 42001 from a blank page to audit-ready. Run the gap analysis, document controls and policies, gather and map evidence, track remediation to done, and get us through audit.

  • Automate compliance instead of just babysitting it: build checks and guardrails so we stay continuously compliant, and help ensure our multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS and beyond) is managed as Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform.

  • Own our compliance evidence end to end: keep it current, mapped, and audit-ready across whatever tooling we run.

  • Support security operations: monitoring, alert triage, and documenting findings.

  • Stay close to how the product is actually built. Our compliance checks run on the same engine we sell customers, so you are testing the product, not filling out paperwork off to the side.

What we are looking for

  • Hands-on experience with at least one of SOC 2, ISO 27001, or ISO 42001: you have run a gap analysis, built and mapped evidence, and taken a program through an actual audit, not just studied the framework. Experience across more than one is a plus.

title: Paid Social | Content Marketing | Internship (m/w/d)
description:
Bei Superchat gestalten wir neu, wie Unternehmen mit ihren Kund:innen kommunizieren. KI wird dabei immer mehr zum Motor dieser Kommunikation. Integrationen sind das, was diesem Motor echte Power gibt: die Daten, Tools und Systeme, die aus einem cleveren AI-Agenten einen machen, der Prozesse wirklich automatisiert und Probleme löst.

Gegründet im Jahr 2020, ist Superchat heute die Plattform für über 10.000 Unternehmen weltweit - von bekannten Marken wie Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone und GASAG bis hin zu kleinen Unternehmen, Zahnarztpraxen und Solo-Founder:innen, die professioneller auftreten möchten.

Inzwischen laufen täglich Millionen von Nachrichten über Superchat.

Gestartet sind wir als Unified Inbox - ein zentraler Ort für alle Kommunikationskanäle wie WhatsApp, E-Mail, SMS oder Instagram. Mit dem Aufstieg von ChatGPT begann unser nächstes Kapitel: AI Agents, die über Chat, E-Mail und Voice in einer Qualität kommunizieren, die mit den besten menschlichen Teams mithalten kann.

Heute sind wir ein Team von rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, arbeiten profitabel und haben insgesamt 18 Millionen Euro Funding eingesammelt (unsere letzte Finanzierungsrunde liegt bereits 4,5 Jahre zurück – seitdem wachsen wir aus eigener Kraft weiter).

Unser Hauptsitz ist in Berlin.

Das sind deine Aufgaben:

  • Du arbeitest aktiv an der Konzeption und Umsetzung von globalen Online-Marketingmaßnahmen
  • Du analysierst und bereitest Kampagnenergebnisse auf, um konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen zur Steigerung der Performance zu entwickeln
  • Du recherchierst und erstellst interessante Inhalten für unsere Paid Social Kanäle wie Instagram, TikTok, Facebook und LinkedIn und unsere Social Media Accounts
  • Du behältst aktuelle Content-Marketing-Trends und Marketing News im Blick und integrierst diese bei uns

Das bringst du mit:

  • Du hast Spaß daran, digital Inhalte für verschiedene Marketingkanäle zu planen und erstellen
  • Du bringst erste praktische Erfahrungen im Bereich Marketing und dem betreuen von verschiedenen Ad-Kanälen oder der Produktion von Videos für Social Media mit
  • Du hast eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und verfügst über ausgeprägte kreative und analytische Fähigkeiten
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und Englisch mindestens auf C1-Niveau, idealerweise noch weitere Sprachen

Why People Choose Us

  • Wir glauben an Zusammenarbeit vor Ort: Wir sind gerne gemeinsam im Berliner Office. Genau dort entstehen die besten Ideen, Entscheidungen werden schneller getroffen, wir lernen voneinander und wachsen als Team enger zusammen. Etwas Flexibilität für Remote Work bieten wir, aber unser Default und unsere Energie liegen im gemeinsamen Office-Alltag
