Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. title: Head of Tokenization
description:
Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

 

Head of Tokenization

 

We are seeking a senior Product leader to drive our strategic expansion from crypto-assets into all tokenized assets so the Talos platform has front-to-back support for tokenized equities, bonds and other emerging asset classes on-chain. You will own this strategic initiative, working closely with the Head of Product Strategy and other product managers to drive go-to-market strategy; client and partner engagement; and setting overall project delivery direction. This position is ultimately accountable for P&L in a new product line.

Responsibilities

 

  • Lead specification, high-level design and delivery of a full tokenized securities venue platform and its integration into Talos, inclusive of all key elements

    • Market structure

    • Liquidity provision, clearing & settlement

    • On-chain vs. off-chain integrations

    • Identity and KYC/AML

    • Regulatory reporting

  • Direct technical product management and Engineering, both dedicated project resources and cross-team dependencies, to ensure rapid, coordinated delivery of the new product

  • Develop and own relationships with early design partners & ecosystem partners

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change, and the toolchain is the new constraint.

Our strategy exists at the intersection of two strong theses:

  2. The $2T European healthcare market is overlooked by the most talented builders.

Our master plan:

In so doing, we’ll become the world’s first trillion-dollar healthcare company.

We’re a young, founder-led company. This is still Day 1 and all our work is ahead of us.

You can read more about working with us here: Working at AIOS

Being a Web Designer at AIOS

We’re building a world-class team.

As Web Designer at AIOS, you’ll own how our brands look and perform on the web, and you’ll own the outcome, not just the pixels. We expect you to do much more than design the website. You’ll find the insight, shape the offer, design the page, build it, ship it and learn from the results.

Flashy design isn’t the job. Getting people to act is. Every page you make should help a real person take the next step towards treatment that can change their life.

title: Senior Product Manager

title: Technical Recruiter, Manufacturing
description:
Swarm Aero is redefining air power, building the largest swarming UAV and the most versatile swarming aircraft network in the world. You'll be a core part of our manufacturing hiring across two sites: our Oxnard HQ and a new facility in Northwest Arkansas. Early on, that means landing the few people who set the foundation. BRIXIO is a cybersecurity and cloud services provider and a Cloudflare Authorised Service Delivery Partner, dual certified in Application Security & Performance and Cloudflare One.

Benefits

  • Ownership: Du verantwortest eines der größten UGC-Teams Deutschlands und den Aufbau in den USA

title: Technical Quality Assurance Manager
description:
The Technical QA Manager is responsible for the technical direction, governance and continual improvement of quality engineering across the organisation’s delivery areas.

The role defines and maintains the overarching test strategy and ensures that quality engineering practices are practical, risk-based and integrated throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

The Technical QA Manager provides direct technical leadership and support to QA Champions and Test Automation Engineers. The role ensures that team testing strategies, automation approaches, quality standards and release evidence are aligned, measurable and consistently applied.

The purpose of the Technical QA Manager role is to:

· Define, communicate and maintain the organisational test strategy and supporting quality engineering standards.

· Enable QA Champions to define and operate effective team and product-area testing strategies.

· Provide technical direction to Test Automation Engineers on automation strategy, framework design, coding standards, CI/CD integration, reusable components, maintainability, diagnostics, test data and execution reliability.

· Ensure automated test execution is embedded into delivery pipelines and provides fast, reliable and actionable feedback.

· Align functional, integration, regression, non-functional and release validation with product, technical and delivery risk.

· Strengthen developer ownership of testing while providing appropriate governance, coaching and assurance.

· Ensure AI-generated testing assets and automation code are reviewed critically before use.

· Defining expectations for pipeline triggers, test execution, quality controls, test-result publication, diagnostic information and failure feedback.

· Ensuring pipeline automation is reliable, maintainable and proportionate to product and release risk.

· Improve release confidence through clear, evidence-based quality and automation reporting.

· Reduce avoidable rework, escaped defects, flaky tests and dependency on manual regression testing.

The Technical QA Manager should be able to:

· Define and implement comprehensive, risk-based test strategies across multiple delivery areas.

· Translate organisational quality objectives into practical engineering standards.

· Demonstrate practical integration of automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.

title: Network Operation Engineer
description:
Network Operations Engineer

1. About the role

Share is the global marketplace for bandwidth. We aggregate telco infrastructure into a single layer and give ISPs, hyperscalers, and AI companies a clean path to deliver connectivity into every home and business across Kenya and the continent. Behind that marketplace is a real network: a BGP edge peering with Tier 1 transit, hyperscalers, and local exchanges, an MPLS backbone, aggregation and access gear, and the systems that watch all of it.

For the partners who run on us, the network is the product, and the NOC is where they feel it. A clean shift is a partner who never knew anything happened. That is the bar.

We are early and the team is small, so we cannot afford a pair of hands that only knows how to escalate. We need a capable network engineer who can stand a shift, resolve real faults without waking anyone, and then keep building the network while East Africa sleeps: propagation and peering checks, health passes across the estate, config changes through to merge, tickets off the board, automation that takes the next repetitive job off everyone's plate. The watching is the floor of this role, not the ceiling.

The NOC you would be joining is not a legacy one. We are building it as an AI assisted operations environment from the ground up. The forwarding plane runs on open source routing and forwarding software, every device configuration lives in Git, and an LLM layer sits on top of the live network state. When something moves, that layer reads the telemetry, correlates it against the topology and the config history, and puts a probable cause and a candidate fix in front of the engineer on shift. The point is not to replace your judgment. It is to collapse the time between an alert firing and you knowing where to look, so mean time to repair is measured in minutes.

You sit inside that system. You use it, you push back on it when it is wrong, and what you catch that it misses is part of how it gets smarter. As we build automation out across the NOC, you are not just a consumer of the tooling. You help write it.

2. What you'll do

Watch, and know what you're looking at. Sit on our monitoring stack (Zabbix and Grafana dashboards, flow telemetry, alerting) and actually read it. Learn what normal looks like so abnormal jumps out at you: a BGP session that dropped, a link that went down, latency climbing on a path, a capacity threshold breached, a partner suddenly pushing or pulling nothing.

Field Station Engineer

About us

Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.

We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked.

Our station network is expanding across Europe, South America, Africa and Australia. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space.

title: Staff Product Designer, Enterprise Products (m/f/d)
description:
We're building a new global Berlitz, and this is your opportunity to help shape it. Nearly 150 years of expertise, meeting the ambition and technology to power a new era of learning.

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz!

A lot of our customers today are enterprise HR and L&D teams, but we haven't given those teams a great way to run what they've bought from us, report on it, and track the value. That gap costs us deals and renewals. We're building our Enterprise customer platform to close that gap. The control center that HR and L&D teams use to manage learners, connect their existing LMS and HR systems, track engagement and CEFR progress, and prove Berlitz's ROI to their own leadership. It serves two very different buyers under one roof: a Global HR Director who checks in occasionally for a strategic view, and an L&D Manager who lives in the tool day to day running the program. Getting both right, with no live product to build on, is the job.

As Staff Product Designer, you'll own design for our Enterprise customer platform from the ground up, reporting directly to the VP of Design. You'll work as an equal partner alongside Product Management and Engineering, and you'll be the first dedicated design hire on this product, so the standards, patterns, and process you set will shape how the team designs enterprise software at Berlitz for years to come.

Your responsibilities

  • Design our Enterprise customer platform end to end, from a mostly blank slate: user management, LMS and HRIS integrations, SSO and provisioning, reporting and ROI dashboards, and the invoicing and admin workflows enterprise buyers expect.

  • Conduct a lot of customer research. Understand deeply our buyer personas, their jobs to be done, their pain points, and their buying triggers. Talk directly and often with HR directors, L&D managers, and procurement teams to build real empathy for people who touch the product a few times a month, not every day.

  • Design for two distinct users in one product: the L&D Manager who needs fast, frequent, operational tools, and the Global HR Director who needs a clear, summarized view of impact across regions.

  • Build within Berlitz's shared design system while extending it with the patterns a data-heavy, enterprise admin product needs.

  • Help set the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Enterprise Products, balancing what buyers ask for

Unser Fokus liegt auf der Entwicklung intelligenter AI Agents, Agentic Workflows, AI Assistants und KI-gestützter Automatisierungslösungen, die messbare geschäftliche Mehrwerte schaffen.

Aktuell entwickeln wir ein eigenes KI-Produkt: eine Plattform, auf der KI-Agenten für Unternehmensprozesse entworfen, orchestriert, betrieben und gesteuert werden. Das Produkt entsteht vollständig in der Microsoft-Cloud (Azure) und wird in C#/.NET umgesetzt. Für die technische Leitung dieses Produkts suchen wir ab sofort Sie als Entwicklungsleiter / Head of Development – AI Agent Platform (m/w/d) – Home Office / remote.

Aufgaben

Sie verantworten die technische Entwicklung des Produkts End-to-End – von der Architektur über die Umsetzung mit einem kleinen, hochqualifizierten Team bis zum stabilen produktiven Betrieb in der Cloud. Sie arbeiten direkt mit der Geschäftsführung und dem Produktmanagement zusammen und haben große Gestaltungsfreiheit.

Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

- Technische Leitung und Architekturverantwortung für die AI Agent Platform auf Basis von Microsoft Azure und C#/.NET

- Entwurf, Programmierung und Weiterentwicklung von KI-Agenten, Multi-Agent-Systemen und Agentic Workflows inklusive Skills, Tools und Function/Tool Calling

- Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Wissensgraphen, RAG-Komponenten, Vektordatenbanken und Wissenssystemen als Grundlage der Agenten

- Integration von Foundation Models und Agent Frameworks im Microsoft-Ökosystem (z. B. Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Semantic Kernel, Agent Framework) sowie von MCP-Servern (Model Context Protocol) zur Anbindung interner und externer Systeme

- Aufbau und Betrieb des kompletten CI/CD-Zyklus: Azure DevOps bzw. GitHub, Infrastructure as Code, automatisierte Tests, Release-Management, Monitoring und Observability

- Übersetzung fachlicher Anforderungen aus Produktmanagement und Kundenprojekten in lauffähige, qualitativ hochwertige Produktinkremente

- Sicherstellung von Sicherheit, Mandantenfähigkeit, Skalierbarkeit, Kostenkontrolle und Betriebsstabilität der Cloud-Plattform

- Technische Führung, Coaching und Weiterentwicklung eines kleinen Entwicklerteams sowie Steuerung externer Entwicklungspartner

title: Praktikum Social Media, Content & Community bei Try It (m/w/d)
description:
100 % remote · Teilzeit möglich · Unbezahltes Praktikum · Start nach Absprache

Die Jacke, die du ständig trägst. Das Secondhand-Teil, für das dir noch eine Kombination fehlt. Ein Blick in einen anderen Kleiderschrank – und plötzlich eine Idee für deinen eigenen.

Your wardrobe has more in it.

Ich bin Christopher, Gründer von Try It. Ich entwickle eine App, mit der du deine Kleidung erfassen, Outfits zusammenstellen und neue Möglichkeiten in deiner eigenen Garderobe entdecken kannst. Was du davon trägst, entscheidest du.

Jetzt suche ich jemanden, der Lust hat, Try It mit mir sichtbar zu machen und eine Community mit aufzubauen. Du bringst deinen Blick auf Mode und Menschen mit. Ich bringe die App, die Geschichte dahinter und mich selbst ein.

Wenn du sagst: „Christopher, zeig das mal“ oder „Ich würde das anders erzählen“, bin ich dabei.

Aufgaben

Was du mitgestalten kannst

Deine Schwerpunkte vereinbaren wir passend zu deinen Erfahrungen, Lernzielen und deiner verfügbaren Zeit.

  • Eigene Inhalte entwickeln und umsetzen. Ein Lieblingsteil anders kombinieren oder zeigen, was tatsächlich im Reisekoffer landet: Du erkennst solche Momente und machst daraus Reels, TikToks oder Storys. Try It wird dabei in echter Nutzung sichtbar.
  • Vor und hinter der Kamera mitwirken. Du entwickelst Formate, filmst und gestaltest Inhalte. Gerne kannst du selbst ausprobieren, erzählen und zeigen oder mich in deine Ideen einbeziehen. Deine Art und dein Humor sind willkommen.
  • Menschen zur Beteiligung einladen. Du greifst Fragen, Geschichten und Outfit-Ideen auf. Daraus können Gespräche, kleine gemeinsame Aktionen und wiederkehrende Formate entstehen.
  • Passende Creator kennenlernen. Du entdeckst Menschen mit einer interessanten Stilwelt und einer echten Verbindung zu ihrer Community. Gemeinsam bereiten wir persönliche Ansprachen vor und entwickeln bei gegenseitigem Interesse Ideen für eine Zusammenarbeit.
  • Beobachtungen zurückbringen. Was haben Menschen wiedererkannt? Was wollten sie ausprobieren? Wo blieb eine Frage offen? Deine Eindrücke helfen dabei, Inhalte und die App weiterzuentwickeln.

Dabei soll Platz für unterschiedliche Menschen, Körper, Budgets und Geschmäcker entstehen. Wer seine Kleidung zeigt, erzählt seine eigene Geschichte und entscheidet selbst, was gefällt.

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

Du interessierst dich für Mode, persönlichen Stil und die Menschen dahinter. Du hast Lust, Try It kennenzulernen und mit deiner eigenen Garderobe auszuprobieren.

Erste praktische Erfahrungen mit Inhalten oder Community-Arbeit sind wichtig. Vielleicht hast du einen eigenen Kanal bewusst weiterentwickelt, einen Account mitbetreut, ein kreatives Projekt umgesetzt oder Mensche

Du willst Systemadministrator Linux nicht einfach administrieren, sondern selbst entscheiden, wie eine moderne Open Source IT Landschaft aussehen soll?🚀

Dann bekommst du hier den Freiraum dafür. Unser Kunde ist ein wachsendes, familiengeführtes Technologieunternehmen aus Freiburg, das Hard- und Softwarelösungen für die industrielle Bildverarbeitung und Automation entwickelt. Die eigenen Systeme kommen heute in mehr als 15.000 Maschinen weltweit zum Einsatz.

Als Systemadministrator Linux verstärkst du einen bewusst klein gehaltenen IT Bereich und bekommst entsprechend viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Statt starrer Konzernstrukturen erwarten dich kurze Wege, direkter Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung und die Möglichkeit, technische Entscheidungen aktiv mitzugestalten. 

Der technologische Fokus liegt konsequent auf Linux und Open Source. In den kommenden Jahren stehen spannende Themen an: bestehende Anwendungen sollen auf Open Source Alternativen migriert, Cyber Security und Resilience weiter ausgebaut und ein eigener interner Linux basierter KI Server kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden. 

Wenn Linux dein fachliches Zuhause ist und du lieber neue Lösungen entwickelst, als nur bestehende Systeme am Laufen zu halten, kannst du hier eine IT Landschaft langfristig mitprägen.

title: Senior Counsel, Strategic Partnerships
Business Unit Head - UK
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a Business Unit Head to build and lead a business from end to end.

You will own the P&L, product, team and execution. You will identify opportunities, decide what to build, hire the team, launch and improve products, and drive growth and profitability.

This is a hands-on operating role with direct accountability for business results.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own P&L, business strategy, targets and overall performance

  • Identify customer needs and commercial opportunities, and decide what products and features to build

  • Work directly with product, engineering and design teams to build and launch products

  • Build the team - hire strong people, set clear goals and manage performance

  • Drive user growth, engagement, revenue and profitability

  • Build partnerships and operations required to launch and scale the business

  • Make decisions quickly, solve problems directly and own execution from idea to results

What We're Looking For

  • Strong track record building, launching

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for a Business Unit Head to build and lead a business from end to end.

You will own the P&L, product, team and execution. You will identify opportunities, decide what to build, hire the team, launch and improve products, and drive growth and profitability.

This is a hands-on operating role with direct accountability for business results.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own P&L, business strategy, targets and overall performance

  • Identify customer needs and commercial opportunities, and decide what products and features to build

  • Work directly with product, engineering and design teams to build and launch products

  • Build the team - hire strong people, set clear goals and manage performance

  • Drive user growth, engagement, revenue and profitability

  • Build partnerships and operations required to launch and scale the business

  • Make decisions quickly, solve problems directly and own execution from idea to results

What We're Looking For

  • Strong track record building, launching

title: Senior DevEx Engineer - Infrastructure
description:
An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Backed by Sofina, Peak XV Partners, ICONIQ, Tencent, Accel, and Balderton, we're building the payments layer the world's best companies rely on.

Watch our showcase >

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

Which team will you be joining?

You'll join Infrastructure, the team that owns the platform every other Primer engineer builds and ships on. CI/CD, deployment, internal tooling, ephemeral environments: if it's how code gets from a laptop to production safely, it's ours.

We operate the way the rest of Primer does. Remote-first, async, high autonomy, low bureaucracy. You build it, you own it, and that includes running it in production. You'll report to the Engineering Manager for Infrastructure & Data and work alongside a small group of senior infrastructure engineers.

What makes this interesting right now is the human-AI development loop. Coding agents are changing how software gets built, and we want someone to own how that actually works at Primer rather than bolting it on. That part of the role is yours to define.

What will you be doing?

  • Own Primer's internal developer platform end to end: the CI/CD pipelines, deployment workflows (canary, blue/green), self-service tooling and ephemeral environments that every engineer here depends on to ship.

  • Build the human-AI development loop. This is the most open part of the role: the tooling and automation that let engineers work effectively alongside coding agents, and the patterns that make agent-driven workflows fast and safe at Primer.

  • Treat developer productivity as a measurable system. Instrument it, find where delivery actually slows down, and ship the changes that fix it instead of guessing.

  • Take real operational ownership. You'll join the Core Infrastructure on-call rotation and own the reliability of what you build.

title: Trainee (m/w/d) im Finanzvertrieb – Karriere mit Struktur, Verantwortung und Perspektive (German Speaking)
description:
Du suchst einen Berufseinstieg, der Vertrieb, Beratung und persönliche Entwicklung verbindet?
Dann ist dieses Traineeprogramm genau das Richtige für dich.

Wir suchen ambitionierte Persönlichkeiten (m/w/d), die sich im Finanzvertrieb eine langfristige Karriere aufbauen wollen, mit klarem System, praxisnaher Ausbildung und individuellen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
Als Trainee wirst du von Beginn an begleitet, gecoacht und gefördert, mit dem Ziel, dich zu einer lizenzierten Finanzberaterin bzw. einem lizenzierten Finanzberater zu entwickeln.

Dein Aufgabenbereich

  • Einstieg in die Finanzberatung: Du lernst, wie du Kundengespräche professionell führst, Bedarfe erkennst und maßgeschneiderte Lösungen anbietest.

  • Vertrieb & Kundenbetreuung: Du unterstützt bei der Akquise und Beratung von Neukunden und baust schrittweise deinen eigenen Kundenstamm auf.

  • Finanzplanung & Analyse: Du erstellst Analysen und Konzepte in den Bereichen Absicherung, Vorsorge, Investment und Vermögensaufbau.

  • Praxisnahe Ausbildung: Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Beratern zusammen und lernst alle Kernprozesse im Vertrieb kennen.

  • Teamarbeit & Mentoring: Du wirst persönlich durch Kevin Kehr begleitet – mit klarer Struktur, Feedback und individueller Förderung.

Wir bieten

  • Lizenzierte Ausbildung: Vorbereitung auf zwei IHK-Abschlüsse gemäß § 34d GewO (Versicherung) und § 34f GewO (Finanzanlagen)

  • Strukturiertes Traineeprogramm: Klare Lernziele, feste Module, begleitende Schulungen und praxisnahe Umsetzung.

  • Persönliches Mentoring: Direkte Begleitung durch deinen Mentor Kevin Kehr, von der ersten Beratung bis zum eigenen Kundenstamm.

  • Hohe Verdienstmöglichkeiten: Leistungsorientierte Vergütung ohne Einkommensbegrenzung.

  • Karriere mit Perspektive: Nach erfolgreichem Abschluss – Einstieg als Finanzberater oder Entwicklung in Richtung Führungskraft.

  • Flexibilität & Eigenverantwortung: Moderne, ortsunabhängige Arbeitsweise mit klarem Fokus auf Ergebnisse.


Das bringst du mit

  • Abitur oder abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein vergleichbarer/höherwertiger Abschluss

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1-Niveau oder Muttersprache)

  • Wohnsitz in Deutschland

About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description
As a Senior Business Development Manager in our Invoice Finance team, you'll take on a more complex and higher-value origination remit, working the largest and most strategically important opportunities across our acquisition channels. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, take the lead on more sophisticated deal structures, and act as a role model and informal mentor to more junior members of the BDM team, while continuing to personally originate and close new business.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Take ownership of a portfolio of higher-value, strategically important Invoice Finance opportunities and introducer relationships

  • Get up to speed on Kriya's most complex deal structures and credit considerations

  • Build relationships with junior BDMs and begin sharing best practice on prospecting and qualification

title: Customer Marketer
description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

About the Customer Marketing team

Customer Marketing sits close to the business so we can hear the reality of customer and commercial conversations first-hand, craft the sharpest possible narrative, and turn what works into scalable programmes and assets.

As a Customer Marketer, you will turn customer, market, and field insight into clear narratives, useful programmes, and concrete actions that improve customer adoption, commercial effectiveness, and business growth.

Concretely, our team works on missions such as:

  • Supporting rollout, adoption, and feedback loops across teams or markets.

  • Bringing field signals back into Marketing, Product, and business decisions.

  • Turning customer discovery and market monitoring into actionable recommendations.

title: Chief Business Officer (gn) @ Clean Data Centres Venture, France (hybrid)
description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio company.

Why we exist

Every frontier model is now gated by two things: megawatts and cooling. Grid queues stretch for years, land is contested, freshwater is political.

Far offshore, the wind blows stronger and steadier than anywhere on Earth, a vast resource the grid can, by definition, never reach.

So we flipped the problem. Instead of bringing power to the load, we bring the load to the power. Our autonomous wind-turbine energy ships chase the wind across the open ocean and convert it on board into what the world needs most: compute first, then e-fuels to decarbonise aviation.

  • 70%+ capacity factor — offshore wind that behaves like baseload

  • ~€50/MWh target cost for firm, low-carbon power

  • Zero grid queue. Zero freshwater. Zero land. And the ocean as the heat sink under every rack.

Founded in 2025 by repeat entrepreneurs (with successful exits) and industrial operators. Backed by major international investors. First demonstrator vessel at sea in late 2027.

The role

This is not a sales job. It's a late co-founder seat. You will own Offshore Compute, our first and main commercial engine: strategy, product, pricing, customers and the multi-million-dollar off-take deals that put our first fleet to work.

You already know that power and thermal limits are what will stall AI scaling. You're bold enough to believe infrastructure at sea can get around both, and rigorous enough to prove it to a sceptical buyer.

What you'll do

  • Write the go-to-market from a blank page. Build the global commercial roadmap, from first demonstrator workloads to full fleet monetisation.

  • Land the anchor deals. Negotiate and close off-take agreements, capacity reservations and JVs with neoclouds, AI labs, CSPs and Tier-1 HPC operators.

  • Turn variable power into a feature. Design offers built for wind-backed power profiles: fault-tolerant batch training, asynchronous inference, dynamic pricing, zero-carbon AI clouds.

  • Connect the C-suite to the hull. Translate client requirements (SLA, latency, direct-to-chip liquid cooling) into onboard architecture specs together with our marine engineers.

  • Create a category. Use our advantages — no grid wait, no freshwater, a direct ocean cooling sink, very low carbon intensity — to win premium pricing and long-term commitments, and establish floating compute as a new asset class.

  • Be the face of it.

title: Provider Credentialing and Practice Lead
description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

The Clinical Practicec Lead owns practice management for Neko Health's United States professional corporation. The role covers four areas: provider credentialing, SOP organization and maintenance, onboarding operationalization, and compliance assurance. Neko runs a tech-enabled clinical model, and this role is expected to run all four through systems and automation rather than manual tracking.

Credentialing: the role holds the credential file for every provider practicing under the PC: license, certification, permitted scope by state, malpractice coverage details and every other expirable, verified at source and kept current so that no provider ever sees a member on a lapsed credential. While Neko does not credential with payers today - this role runs the credentialing gate that clears a provider to practice and removes that clearance when a credential lapses. It supplies provider credentialing data into the clinic compliance systems and works to the credentialing standard and clear-to-practice definition set by the Head of Compliance.

SOPs: the role owns the SOP library for US practice operations. The role keeps every SOP current, versioned, and easy to find, and retires SOPs that no longer apply.

Onboarding: the role turns each new provider's onboarding plan into a working, tracked sequence: credentialing, system access, training, and clearance to start, in the right order and against a clear timeline.

Compliance: the role checks that US practice operations meet the standards set by the Head of Compliance, and reports gaps as they surface.

Systems and automation: the role chooses, configures and owns the tooling that carries all of the above — one source of truth for provider data, automated expiry alerts, and workflows that hand off cleanly between Talent Acquisition, the People Team, IT and clinical operations. Status should be visible from the system rather than assembled by hand.

title: HR Generalist - EMEA
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

We are looking for an HR Generalist to join our People team and support our growing EMEA organization. This is an early-career role built for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and eager to learn how a world-class People function operates at one of the fastest-growing technology companies in the world.
You will be a key point of contact for employees across the region—owning the day-to-day administration of benefits, employment documents, and contracts, while also helping to build the kind of culture and community that makes Applied Intuition a place people are proud to work. If you are early in your career and want a front-row seat to how a $15 billion company operates across Europe, this is the role for you.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

  • Administer and coordinate employee benefits across EMEA countries, serving as the first point of contact for employee questions and working closely with providers to ensure smooth day-to-day operations

  • Leverage AI tools to automate repetitive tasks, improve documentation workflows, and free up time for the work that actually moves the needle

  • Draft, manage, and maintain employment contracts, offer letters, and HR documents with a high standard of accuracy and attention to detail

title: Senior Manager
description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team

Our Defence team is focused on building and embedding human-centered AI solutions which give our nation a competitive edge in the defence sector. We collaborate with our clients to bring ethical, reliable and cutting-edge AI to high-stakes situations and maintain the balance of global powers essential to our liberty.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Defence clients, you will need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work between 2 to 4 days per week on-site with these customers which may require travel to locations throughout the UK.

When not required on client sites, you’ll have the flexibility to work from our London office or remotely from elsewhere within the UK.

About the role

As a Senior Manager within our Defence team, you’ll lead critical work for discerning and highly AI-literate customers across the UK Defence landscape and for our international partners. This is a fast-paced and demanding role that requires deep mission-area context, programme delivery mastery, and the ability to think creatively about the role of AI in national security.

You can expect to lead high-stakes portfolios of work, ranging from the experimental application of emerging technologies to robust products that we progress through a complete development lifecycle and deploy for users in frontline commands.

title: Lead Enterprise Architect, Professional Services
description:
Intelance helps organisations make clear, evidence based decisions about technology. We are looking for a freelance Lead Enterprise Architect to run a fixed scope enterprise architecture review for a large UK professional services firm, and to stay on as the firm’s interim architect if the client takes the follow on work. You will lead the work day to day. Intelance’s engagement partner stays accountable for the engagement and the client relationship.

The review runs over four to six weeks from November 2026 and needs around 18 days. The optional follow on is two days a week for eight weeks, then a short check around 90 days after the review, finishing around early March 2027. The work is mainly remote within the UK, with some days at client offices in England agreed in advance.

Tasks

  • Lead the review from the first meeting to the final presentation, as the client’s day to day contact.
  • Start from the records the client already keeps, such as integration documents, system lists and project records.
  • Run eight to ten one hour conversations with the heads of applications, IT operations, data, client solutions and the project office.
  • Build one clear picture of the whole technology estate: systems, connections, data flows and owners.
  • Trace two or three recent technology decisions from the first request to the current owner.
  • Write a priority risk report and three costed options for how the firm should own technology decisions, always including keeping its current model.
  • Present the findings and options to the Chief Operating Officer with Intelance’s engagement partner.
  • If the follow on goes ahead, act as the firm’s interim architect two days a week. Set up a technology decision forum, prepare the first three decisions for it and hand over the estate map as a working tool.

Requirements

  • Experience as a lead or head of enterprise architecture in a UK law firm, or in another professional services partnership of around 1,000 people or more.
  • You have set up an architecture function, design authority or technology decision forum from scratch.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform. Knowledge of Aderant, InterAction or legal document management systems is a strong plus.
  • You write costed options papers yourself and present them with confidence to a Chief Operating Officer or board.
  • You work well alongside capable internal teams and build on what they already have.
  • Independent of software vendors. You must not currently work for, or resell products from, a legal software supplier, a Microsoft partner or an IT services provider to the client.
  • Available from early November 2026 to early March 2027, at three to four days a week during the review.

title: Physician - Clinical AI Expert (Remote)
description:
We are seeking physicians to review, validate and design clinical tasks to help advance frontier AI models across a range of clinical scenarios and formats.

The project is designed to surface where models perform poorly in clinical scenarios such missed findings, incorrect clinical information, overconfidence or failure to seek context before answering.

You will work asynchronously on a dedicated platform, within your own specialty and day-to-day scope of practice.

This is a remote, flexible and short-term project.

Key Responsibilities

  • Scenario Design: Design realistic clinical scenarios and instructions that mirror the work you carry out day-to-day in your specialty.

  • Content Review: Assess clinical outputs for accuracy, flagging anything incorrect, outdated or can cause harm.

  • Reference Answer Validation: Judge whether reference answers reflect what you would actually write in practice, including caveats, uncertainty and requests for further information.

  • Grading Criteria Assessment: Design and evaluate whether scoring criteria capture what matters clinically and whether each is weighted appropriately, particularly safety-critical items.

  • Written Rationale: Provide short, specific reasoning where you disagree, and note the weakness each new item is designed to expose.

  • Feedback & Continuous Improvement: Highlight edge cases and ambiguity to refine guidelines and improve consistency across reviewers.


Qualifications

  • Licensure: Registered doctor based in the US, Europe or Asia-Pacific.

  • Experience: Current or recent clinical practice in your stated specialty.

  • Knowledge: Strong grounding in current guidelines, diagnostic reasoning and clinical documentation standards.

  • Attention to detail: Proven accuracy and consistency in clinical review or assessment work.

  • Technical proficiency: Comfortable using structured review tools and digital platforms.

  • Language: Native or near-native written English.


Legal Status

  • You will have the right to work in your country of residence.

We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We’re approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We’re a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

Job Summary

We’re looking for a systems-minded Staff Product Manager to take Constructor’s search and discovery to the state of the art — and keep it there — across every retail industry we serve. This is a highly technical, high-leverage role at the core of our Product Discovery Engine chapter: the teams responsible for how we retrieve, understand, and rank the right products for every shopper, on every query, for every customer.

Your job is to raise discovery quality and, through it, our customers’ business metrics. You won’t be measured on features shipped — you’ll be measured on relevance and business outcomes, like conversion, revenue per visit, and search-attributed GMV, moving up.

You’ll start embedded with our Search Quality team, owning its strategy and roadmap and getting deep into the systems that decide what shoppers actually see. Over time, your mandate grows to setting direction for the entire Product Discovery Engine chapter — deciding where we’re heading and why across recall, ranking, query understanding, personalization, and the ML infrastructure underneath. This is a Staff role today with a clear path to Director as you take on chapter-wide leadership.

Search at Constructor is fundamentally a machine learning problem, so this role lives and breathes ML. You’ll partner closely with ML, data science, and engineering to turn the latest research into production wins, keep us ahead of both commercial competitors and academic state of the art, and be the connective tissue that aligns multiple teams — ML Recall, ML Infra, and, over time, teams like CORE, SABR, and Catalog Management — behind a single, coherent vision for great discovery.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
This is Cradle

Proteins are the molecular machines of life, used for many therapeutic, diagnostic, chemical, agricultural and food applications. Designing and optimizing proteins takes a lot of expert knowledge and manual effort, through the use of custom computational and biological tools.

Machine learning is revolutionizing this space, by enabling high-fidelity protein models. At Cradle, we offer a software platform for AI-guided discovery and optimization of proteins, so that biologists can design proteins faster and at scale. We are already used by clients across biopharma, biotech, agri-tech, food-tech, and academia.

We're an experienced team of just under 100 people. We've built many successful products before and have enough funding for multiple years of runway. We are distributed across three offices in Amsterdam, Boston, and Zurich, alongside a few remote colleagues.

We offer our employees a very competitive salary, a generous equity stake in the company and a wide range of benefits and career progression opportunities.

The Role

As Executive Assistant at Cradle, you'll keep two of our founding executives moving. Between customer visits, investor meetings, hiring and travel across Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, there's a lot to keep track of, and your job is to make sure nothing gets dropped. You'll own their calendars, inboxes and travel, and take care of the personal admin that would otherwise eat into their time. This role suits someone who likes being trusted with the whole picture, professional and personal, and treats both with the same care.

Responsibilities

  • Run two calendars as one system: Protect focus time, balance competing priorities across time zones, and decide what deserves a meeting and what can be an email.

  • Own the inbox front line: Triage, draft and reply on their behalf to customers, investors, candidates and the team, so the important things surface and the rest gets handled.

  • Plan travel end to end: Customer visits, conferences and trips between Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, from flights and hotels to the meeting room and dinner booking on the other side.

  • Take care of personal and life admin: Appointments, household logistics, official paperwork, bills and renewals, handled so none of it lands on their desks.

  • Prepare every important meeting: Make sure briefs and context are ready beforehand, and follow up on decisions and action items afterwards.<

title: Business Analyst KI-Prozessautomatisierung (m/w/d)
description:
Wir bei KnowWay entwickeln KI-Agenten für kritische Infrastruktur – Energie, Telekommunikation und öffentlicher Sektor. Überall dort, wo Compliance, Nachvollziehbarkeit und Datensouveränität keine Kompromisse zulassen, automatisieren wir Geschäftsprozesse mit KI.

Dabei begleiten wir unsere Kunden über den gesamten Daten- und KI-Lebenszyklus: von Daten und Datenqualität über KI-Verarbeitung bis zur Integration in produktive Systeme.

Das Projekt

Für einen führenden Telekommunikationskonzern in Deutschland setzen wir Daten- und KI-Projekte auf der Google Cloud um. Mehrere Anwendungsfälle laufen parallel – von Discovery und Business Analyse über PoCs und Entwicklung bis zum Live-Betrieb.

Die Prozesse, die wir automatisieren, sind oft über Jahre gewachsen. Wissen steckt in einzelnen Köpfen, Abläufe sind nur teilweise dokumentiert und Fachbereiche arbeiten mit selbst entwickelten Excel-, Access-, SharePoint- oder anderen Legacy-Lösungen.

Genau dort setzt Deine Rolle an.

Aufgaben

Die Rolle

Du verstehst, was im Fachbereich wirklich passiert – und bereitest es so auf, dass daraus ein umsetzbarer Daten- oder KI-Anwendungsfall entsteht.

Dafür arbeitest Du direkt mit Sachbearbeiter, Projektleitungen und Entscheider. Du findest heraus, wo das eigentliche Problem liegt, welche Regeln tatsächlich gelten und wie ein Prozess funktioniert. Du modellierst Abläufe und Entscheidungslogiken und machst sie für unser Delivery-Team nutzbar.

Dabei gehst Du über klassische Business Analyse hinaus: Du arbeitest heraus, auf welchen Daten ein Prozess basiert, welche Objekte und Beziehungen existieren, aus welchen Systemen die Daten stammen und was in den einzelnen Verarbeitungsschritten mit ihnen passiert.

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Solution Architect sowie unseren Data-, AI- und Software-Engineers zusammen. Du musst keine Datenpipeline bauen und keinen produktiven Code schreiben. Du solltest aber Datenflüsse verstehen und einschätzen können, was technisch möglich ist – und was das für den Fachbereich bedeutet.

Gleichzeitig bist Du eine zentrale Ansprechperson für Deine Use Cases: Du gibst Statusupdates, bereitest Entscheidungen vor, managst Erwartungen und treibst offene Punkte voran.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Anforderungen durch Workshops, Interviews und Prozessbeobachtung herausarbeiten – auch wenn Prozesse bisher kaum dokumentiert sind
  • Ist-Prozesse sowie fachliche Regeln und Entscheidungslogiken analysieren und modellieren, insbesondere mit BPMN
  • Datenobjekte, Beziehungen, Quellsysteme und Schlüssel hinter einem Prozess identifizieren und visualisieren
  • Datenflüsse nachvollziehen und Auswirkungen von Datenqualität und Datenverfügbarkeit auf Anforderungen erkennen
  • Prozessdiagramme, Fachkonzepte, Entscheidungsvorlagen und Präsentationen erstellen

title: Fractional Chief Medical Officer  - Tricorder Systems
description:
Fractional Chief Medical Officer — Project Tricorder

We're looking for a clinician who has served as a military medic to be Tricorder's clinical lead and the medical name behind the product. You'll shape clinical workflows, protect patient safety, help to roadmap clinical device regulation, giving the product credibility with clinicians, defence customers and investors.

About Project Tricorder - https://www.tricorder-systems.com/

Most healthcare technology assumes a hospital: reliable power, connectivity and a clinician at a desk. But the moments that decide outcomes often happen elsewhere: at the point of injury, in transit, in remote and contested environments, and in the critical minutes before a patient reaches a ward.

Tricorder is building deployable clinical infrastructure for that world. It's a rugged, self-contained hardware and software platform that lets clinical teams capture, monitor and act on patient data anywhere, even when the network or the grid can't be relied on. It's a dual-use venture serving defence medical first and civilian pre-hospital and humanitarian care next.

Tricorder is being built inside Founders Factory's venture studio, with dedicated pre-seed investment and a six-month build programme. The founder, a former British Army officer, is in place, the founding engineer is incoming, and a few more team hires are underway.

What you'll do

You'll be Tricorder's senior clinical voice: the person who makes sure what we build works for a medic at the point of injury and keeps patients safe.

  • Shape clinical workflows: map how casualties are assessed, treated, handed over and evacuated, from the point of injury through to definitive care. Turn that into product requirements, and test prototypes against real resuscitation and trauma scenarios.

  • Protect patient safety: lead clinical risk management and act as (or help appoint) the Clinical Safety Officer under the NHS DCB0129 standard. Advise on the evidence needed for the medical device and regulatory pathway.

  • Be the medical face of the product: put your clinical name to Tricorder. Represent it to defence medical services, NHS and ambulance trusts, humanitarian organisations and investors, and help the founder carry the clinical story in pitches and pilots.

Intro

Du möchtest an einer Legal-Tech-Anwendung arbeiten, die für E-Commerce-Unternehmen wie eine digitale Rechtsabteilung funktioniert? Du denkst Systeme vom Datenmodell bis zur Oberfläche, konzipierst gern technische Lösungen und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, dass sie am Ende auch so umgesetzt werden? Dann bist du als Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) / Senior Webentwickler PHP/Laravel (m/w/d) beim Händlerbund genau richtig!

  • Fullstack-Entwicklung: Umsetzung mit Laravel, Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS. Kleinere Projekte eigenständig von Anfang bis Ende, größere im Projektteam.

  • Partneranbindungen & Integrationen: Lösungsevaluierung, Umsetzung und Dokumentation von Schnittstellen zu Partner- und Drittsystemen.

title: Senior IT Security Specialist (gn)
description:
Einleitung

Mehr Verantwortung. Mehr Einfluss. 
Standort: Hamburger Westen | Hybrid (60% remote)

Du hast schon einige Security-Projekte gesehen.
Einige liefen genau so, wie sie geplant waren. Andere haben dich vermutlich mehr gelehrt als jede Zertifizierung.
Genau deshalb könnte diese Rolle spannend für dich sein.

Sondern weil der verantwortliche Teamleiter IT-Security mittlerweile so viele Themen verantwortet, dass er einen Teil davon in erfahrene Hände geben möchte.
Gesucht wird also niemand, der Tickets bearbeitet oder Häkchen in Audits setzt.
Gesucht wird jemand, der Verantwortung übernehmen möchte.


Deine Aufgaben

Dein Alltag wird sich irgendwo zwischen operativer Security, Cloud Security und Projektarbeit bewegen.

Unter anderem geht es um:

  • Security Reviews neuer Systeme, Anwendungen und Technologien

  • Bearbeitung von Findings aus Audits

Aktuell entstehen viele neue Themen und Veränderungen. Entsprechend gibt es ausreichend Möglichkeiten, eigene Erfahrungen einzubringen und Dinge mitzugestalten.


Dein Profil

Uns ist bewusst, dass niemand jede Anforderung perfekt erfüllt.
Wichtiger ist:

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich IT Security
  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-Technologien und Cloud Security ist ein Must-Have

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.


The Role

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to support hiring across multiple functions and regions as BJAK continues to scale globally.

This is a hands-on recruitment role for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple hiring priorities, and partnering closely with stakeholders to deliver hiring outcomes. You will have exposure to a wide range of functions including Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Product, Engineering, and other business-critical teams.


What You’ll Do

  • Manage end-to-end recruitment processes for assigned roles across multiple functions and locations.

  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, candidate profiles, and business priorities.

  • Source, screen, assess, and engage candidates through various channels including LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, job boards, and direct outreach.

  • Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for both active and future hiring needs.

  • Conduct talent mapping and market research to support hiring strategies.

  • Coordinate and manage interview processes while ensuring a positive candidate experience.

  • Maintain accurate candidate records and recruitment activities within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

  • Provide regular hiring updates and pipeline insights to hiring managers and stakeholders.

  • Support recruitment process improvements, hiring initiatives, and employer branding activities where required.

title: Copy of Research Scientist / Engineer – Performance Optimization
description:
You'll make Luma's multimodal models fast — profiling and optimizing GPU, CPU, and accelerator code so they train efficiently and deploy at scale without sacrificing quality. You'll write the kernels and operations that get the most out of the hardware.

This is deep performance work: fused kernels, tensor cores, Triton and CUDA, distributed multi-node deployment. It fits someone with expert GPU-optimization skills and a deep understanding of transformer internals. If you're not at home in CUDA, Triton, and profilers, this is the wrong depth.

What You'll Own

  • Profile and optimize GPU/CPU/accelerator code for maximum utilization and minimal latency.

What You Bring

  • Expert-level Triton/CUDA programming and GPU optimization.

  • Strong PyTorch skills, including kernel development and custom operations.

  • Proficiency with profiling tools (NVIDIA Nsight, torch profiler, custom tooling).

  • Deep understanding of transformer architectures and attention mechanisms.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with compilers and exporters (torch.compile, TensorRT, ONNX, XLA).

  • Experience optimizing inferen

title: Senior UICC/eUICC/eSIM Engineer
Independent Consultant - Sustainable Bio-Materials & Regulatory Compliance
description:
RSB – Roundtable on Sustainable Biomaterials is a global, multi-stakeholder organisation dedicated to driving the truly sustainable development of the bioeconomy. Frequently recognised as an industry leader in supply chain sustainability, RSB applies its best-in-class sustainability framework across sectors including aviation, chemicals, materials, and shipping.

Our small, dedicated team operates remotely from countries around the world, working collaboratively with a diverse base of member organisations, industry partners, and policymakers. For more information, please visit www.rsb.org.

Purpose of This Call

RSB now invites eligible firms and individuals (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services described below. This Call for Expressions of Interest is not yet linked to a specific project or immediate assignment. RSB is building a pre-approved External Consultant Roster: a qualified pool of selected specialists and organisations that will be called upon for project-based work for the next 2-3 years.

We are primarily seeking to engage consultancy firms, agencies, and other established organisations, providers that can offer dedicated capacity, depth of expertise, and continuity across assignments. At the same time, we warmly welcome expressions of interest from independent consultants and other individual specialists whose qualifications and experience match the profiles sought. Throughout this document, “Consultant” refers to both firms and individuals unless stated otherwise.

Consultants accepted onto the roster will complete a brief onboarding process to become familiar with RSB’s systems, ways of working, and sustainability framework, so that engagements can begin efficiently when a relevant need is identified. When a specific project or capacity gap emerges, RSB will contact roster members whose profile best matches the assignment, share a defined scope of work, and invite them to submit a proposal.

Inclusion on the roster is an expression of readiness and fit and not a guarantee of immediate work or remuneration.

The Services

The Sustainable Bio-Materials & Regulatory Compliance Consultant will provide regulatory compliance and sustainability assessment expertise for bio-based materials, sustainable fuels, feedstocks and related value chains. Consultants in this profile support RSB Advisory Services with the expert practical interpretation of regulatory frameworks, such as EU RED, CORSIA and relevant voluntary certification requirements, including their GHG calculation methodologies. They support feedstock eligibility, low-ILUC considerations, sustainability-risk screening, voluntary scheme benchmarking and compliance gap identification.

title: Clinical Data & Quality Manager

Resilience Care, a leading player in remote medical monitoring and a partner in clinical research, is a French company founded in 2021 with a single mission: to provide better care.

Our company offers remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology, and psychiatry, based on the collection of ePROs combined with AI technologies.   • Cloud First mitgestalten: Du bist federführend mit dabei, Azure, M365 und die hybride Identity weiterzuentwickeln – und denkst mit, welcher Weg dorthin realistisch ist.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:

You’re a self-driven, highly capable recruiter who thrives in fast-moving environments and is energized by the challenge of finding talent that can build the best products. You’re deeply curious, technically fluent, and confident engaging with engineering and product candidates who are solving some of the hardest problems in AI and personalization. You are comfortable owning every part of the process and serving as a thoughtful brand ambassador from first outreach to offer. You are excited to help scale a team that’s redefining the future of ecommerce.

About Us

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents. Engineering is by far our largest department, and we’ve built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We’re passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so.

Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and with customers across many countries. It is used by some of the biggest ecommerce companies in the world like Sephora, Under Armour, and Petco.

We’re a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.

Constructor is a U.S. based company that has been in the market since 2019. It was founded by Eli Finkelshteyn and Dan McCormick who still lead the company today.

Recruiting at Constructor

Constructor has grown headcount over 180% in the last two and a half years with a lean team: a small recruiting team and the support of our hiring managers. We’re excited to continue growing and to bring on a Technical Recruiter that will focus on roles across our Engineering and or Product team. These teams are distributed across North America, APAC, LATAM, and EMEA. Given the technical nature of our product, prior experience recruiting for technical roles is required. We're looking for someone excited to partner closely with hiring managers and help us scale intentionally and effectively across regions.

title: Senior Procurement Manager
description:
We are seeking a Procurement Manager to lead sourcing, supplier management, and purchasing operations while ensuring a reliable, cost-effective supply of materials that supports production, inventory, and business growth.

The Procurement Manager is responsible for leading the procurement function to ensure a reliable and cost-effective supply of materials supporting manufacturing operations. This role develops and executes procurement strategies, manages supplier performance, partners cross-functionally to support production requirements, and drives continuous improvement initiatives that optimize inventory, reduce costs, and strengthen supply chain performance.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify and implement cost reduction initiatives while maintaining product quality and supply continuity.

  • Collaborate with Planning, Operations, Engineering, and Manufacturing to ensure material availability supports production schedules.

  • Analyze purchasing trends, supplier performance, and market conditions to identify opportunities for improvement and mitigate supply chain risks.

  • Manage procurement activities to optimize inventory levels while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory.

  • Develop contingency plans to reduce supplier risk and improve supply continuity.

  • Support new product introductions through supplier sourcing, qualification, and procurement planning.

  • Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies, contractual requirements, and ethical sourcing standards.

  • Provide leadership and direction for the procurement function by coaching and developing the Buyer while building a high-performing procurement organization.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve procurement processes, supplier performance, and operational efficiency.

  • Prepare and present procurement metrics, supplier scorecards, savings initiatives, and performance reports to leadership.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 6 or more years of procurement, purchasing, or supply chain experience within a manufacturing environment required.

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field preferred; or equivalent directly related work experience.

  • Demonstrated experience negotiating supplier agreements and managing strategic supplier relationships.

  • Previous experience leading, coaching, or developing employees, direct reports, or project teams is required.

  • Experience with MRP/ERP systems and procurement planning.

  • Strong understanding of inventory management, production planning, and manufacturing operations.

  • Proven ability to analyze data, identify trends, and develop strategic procurement solutions.

  • Excel

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. title: Machine Learning Scientist
description:
About Nucs AI

Nucs AI is revolutionizing cancer care through cutting-edge AI and medical imaging technology. Founded in 2024 by a multidisciplinary team of oncologists, AI researchers, and healthcare innovators, we’re tackling one of medicine’s most pressing challenges: the growing demand for accurate, timely cancer diagnostics in the face of rising scan volumes and limited radiologist capacity.

We sit at the intersection of diagnostics and treatment planning—building AI-powered tools at the convergence of medical imaging, radioligand therapy, and artificial intelligence. Starting with prostate cancer and expanding across oncology, we partner with world-leading medical institutions and pharmaceutical companies across the US, Europe, and Australia to bring precision oncology into everyday clinical practice.

Our mission is to enhance diagnostic precision and expand access to expert-level cancer care, improving patient outcomes worldwide. We’re venture-backed, early-stage, and building a team that blends deep clinical expertise with engineering intensity—moving with the rigor the medical field demands and the speed the problem deserves.

The Opportunity

Nucs AI is looking for a Machine Learning Scientist to deepen our ML research capabilities in clinical oncology. This is a senior, research-oriented role for someone who wants to develop novel approaches to medical image analysis, treatment outcome prediction, and multi-modal clinical data integration - and see those methods reach real clinical settings.

You’ll work at the intersection of ML research and clinical application, collaborating closely with physicians, medical physicists, and experienced engineers with deep domain expertise. Together, you’ll develop methods that are scientifically rigorous and clinically meaningful. Your work will directly shape our product capabilities and contribute to peer-reviewed science.

What You’ll Do

Research & Method Development

  • Develop novel ML/DL methods for medical image analysis, including segmentation, lesion detection, longitudinal tracking, treatment response prediction, and outcome modeling

  • Design and conduct experiments to evaluate new approaches against clinical baselines and state-of-the-art methods

  • Stay current with the literature and propose research directions that advance Nucs AI’s product and scientific

title: Research Scientist / Engineer – Reinforcement Learning Infrastructure
description:
You'll build the systems that make reinforcement learning work at frontier scale — coupling policy optimization with large fleets of inference workers, agentic environments, and the reward and verification systems that turn model behavior into learning signal. RL is how Luma's models go from capable to useful.

RL at scale is a full-loop systems problem: training, rollout generation, environment execution, and reward computation running concurrently across thousands of GPUs, all needing to stay fast, stable, and correct together. It fits someone who has lived this — post-trained LLMs with RL, built environments and verifiers, and debugged asynchronous rollout pipelines at scale. If you haven't operated RL at real scale, this will be deep water.

What You'll Own

  • Design, build, and scale distributed RL post-training systems, orchestrating trainer, rollout, environment, and reward workloads across thousands of GPUs.

  • Build high-throughput rollout generation, integrating inference engines (vLLM, SGLang), weight synchronization, and asynchronous/off-policy schemes.

  • Design RL environments for agentic, multi-step tasks — sandboxed code execution, tool use, computer use, multimodal interaction — reproducible and scalable to millions of episodes.

  • Build reward infrastructure: verifiable/programmatic rewards, reward-model serving, LLM-as-judge pipelines, and defenses against reward hacking.

  • Develop the evaluation, monitoring, and debugging tooling that keeps large RL runs stable.

  • Advance training efficiency and stability, and turn new post-training ideas into production runs with researchers.

First 90 Days

One way the first 90 could unfold.

  • Days 1–30 — Immerse & Diagnose: Learn the current RL stack and where throughput, stability, or correctness break.

  • Days 30–60 — Ship & Validate: Improve a piece of the loop (rollout throughput, reward infra, or an environment) and prove it on a real run.

  • Days 60–90 — Scale & Systemize: Harden the full loop across thousands of GPUs and asynchronous architectures.

What You Bring

  • Hands-on experience post-training LLMs with RL (PPO/GRPO-family, RLHF, RLVR) at meaningful scale.

  • Extensive distributed PyTorch tr

title: Senior Tax Manager (gn)
description:
Your mission

The Bikeleasing Group continues to grow and is expanding its international tax function. As a Senior Tax Manager (gn), your initial focus will be on our tax matters in Germany. At the same time, you will have the opportunity to develop international topics and structures together with the relevant stakeholders. Close collaboration with external tax advisory firms, specialist departments, authorities and our parent company will be part of your daily work. The position can be performed remotely from anywhere in Germany and includes occasional business travel. Sounds good? Then we look forward to getting to know you.
Your tasks

  • You will manage the Bikeleasing Group’s tax matters independently, initially with a focus on Germany and increasingly on international topics in the future
  • You will prepare tax returns, tax declarations, input tax refund claims and withholding tax applications carefully and on time
  • You will be responsible for tax calculations in accordance with the German Commercial Code (HGB) as well as the IFRS reporting package for our parent company
  • You will continuously monitor, document and optimise intra-group transfer pricing
  • You will actively contribute your expertise to VAT-related matters and tax audits
  • As the central point of contact for specialist departments, external tax advisory firms and authorities, you will provide clarity on complex tax matters
  • You will further develop international tax topics and tax processes together with the relevant stakeholders


Your profile

  • A completed degree in business administration, economics or law with a focus on taxation, or a comparable qualification
  • At least five years of professional experience in the tax department of a company or at an auditing or tax advisory firm
  • In-depth knowledge of German tax law and, ideally, international tax law
  • Practical experience with accounting in accordance with the German Commercial Code (HGB) and, ideally, knowledge of IFRS
  • Familiarity with group structures and the related accounting requirements
  • A successfully completed German tax consultant examination is desirable
  • A structured and precise approach to work, as well as confidence when dealing with authorities and external partners

🏢 Who we are

A team from Germany with the vision to make advanced network security accessible for everyone

We are a software company developing an open source zero-trust network security platform that is both easy to use and affordable for teams of all sizes and budgets. Our mission is grounded in a simple yet powerful belief: secure private networking is a fundamental right of every modern company.

Since our launch on GitHub in 2021, we have gained trust among thousands of companies seeking secure and seamless solutions for connecting remote employees and infrastructure. You will:

  • Own full-cycle hiring across Engineering, GTM and Operations, from role kickoff to offer and close.

  • Source proactively for hard technical roles (Go, networking, platform, security), through GitHub, the open source community, events and your own network, instead of waiting for inbound.
