Remote-first, Büro in Karlsruhe | ab sofort | unbefristet ab Tag eins

4.500–7.000 EUR Bruttofixgehalt pro Monat plus 1–3 % Provision auf den provisionsfähigen Ertrag deiner abgeschlossenen Aufträge. Deine Einordnung im Fixgehaltsband richtet sich nach deiner relevanten Erfahrung und der Abschlussverantwortung, die du übernimmst. Berechnungsbasis und Provisionssätze sind im Provisionsmodell transparent festgelegt.

Warum deine Mission zählt

Informationssicherheit entscheidet heute darüber, ob ein Unternehmen handlungsfähig bleibt. Unsere Kunden sind Mittelständler und KRITIS-Organisationen, die NIS2 und steigende Anforderungen nicht als Formular sehen wollen, sondern als Schutz, der trägt.

Als Andockoffizier bist du die Person, bei der aus Interesse eine Entscheidung wird. Du führst Strategiegespräche mit Geschäftsführung und IT-Leitung, schaffst Entscheidungssicherheit und bringst die Beauftragung über die Ziellinie. Andocken heißt: zwei Seiten verbinden sich fest. Genau das ist deine Aufgabe.

Du verkaufst nicht, was ein Hersteller vorgibt. Du verkaufst, was unsere Crew wirklich umsetzt, und du kannst es auch in einem Jahr noch vertreten.

Was dich erwartet

Deine Rolle an Bord

Du übernimmst vorqualifizierte Bedarfe. Erstkontakt und Terminierung liegen bei einer Agentur oder einem anderen Crew-Mitglied, das Mehrwertgespräch führt unsere Fachseite. Wenn ein Gespräch bei dir ankommt, ist der Bedarf geprüft. Deine Aufgabe beginnt dort, wo es um die Entscheidung geht.

Strategiegespräche führen

  • Problem-, Ziel- und Nutzenbild gemeinsam mit dem Kunden schärfen

  • Entscheidungsweg, Kriterien und Beteiligte offenlegen

  • Jedes Gespräch mit bestätigtem Ergebnis und verbindlichen nächsten Schritten beenden

Abschluss steuern

  • Angebote strukturieren, Optionen klar darstellen, Einwände und Risiken offen adressieren

  • Verbindliche Entscheidungsfahrpläne mit Kunden vereinbaren, wo nötig, führst du das Entscheidungsgespräch

  • Einkauf, Laufzeiten, Leistungsumfang und Vertragspunkte verhandeln

  • Beauftragung abschließen, Kick-off vereinbaren und die Übergabe an die Umsetzung sicherstellen

Vom Einstieg zum Mandat

  • Du schließt unsere Einstiegsprodukte ab, z. B. ISO 27001-Bestandsaufnahme, NIS2-Startpaket oder CRA-Startpaket

  • Daraus entwickelst du Folgeaufträge über Mandate und Services, z. B. ISO 27001-Einführung oder NIS2-Umsetzung mit ISB-Mandat, Kryptoinventar- & SBOM-as-a-Service

Fachliche Rückendeckung

  • Bei der Lösungsarchitektur sitzt die Fachseite mit am Tisch. Du musst Technik nicht allein verkaufen

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung, ohne Freigabeweg über mehrere Ebene

Du verantwortest unsere organische Präsenz, von der Idee bis zum fertigen Post. Sivara ist eine Damen-Unterwäsche- und Umstandsmode-Brand mit über 120.000 Kundinnen, unsere Community redet viel mit uns, und genau da entsteht dein Content.

  • Du betreust unsere Affiliate- und Deal-Partner, findest neue Partner und baust den Kanal mit aus.
  • Du entwickelst, wie unsere Kanäle klingen und aussehen, schaust dir an was funktioniert hat und was nicht, und planst den nächsten Monat danach.

  • Du schneidest selbst und sicher, mit CapCut, Premiere oder einem vergleichbaren Tool.

Performance & Progression

  • Own the engineering performance and progression approach.

title: Analytical Chemistry Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analytical Chemistry Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Netherlands.

Are you an analytical chemistry expert interested in contributing to the next generation of artificial intelligence? This freelance opportunity allows you to apply your scientific expertise to train and evaluate advanced AI models designed to support scientific discovery, education, and laboratory research. You will assess AI-generated responses to complex analytical chemistry questions, identify inaccuracies, and strengthen scientific reasoning across a wide range of applications. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical relevance of AI-generated scientific knowledge. Working remotely and independently, you will contribute specialized insights to the development of more capable and trustworthy AI systems. This role is ideal for experienced chemistry professionals who enjoy solving complex problems, communicating scientific concepts, and exploring the intersection of chemistry and emerging technology.


Accountabilities
  • Evaluate AI-generated scientific content: Review responses to theoretical and practical analytical chemistry questions, assessing their factual accuracy, logical consistency, scientific rigor, and relevance to real-world laboratory applications.
  • Apply specialized analytical chemistry knowledge: Develop and evaluate scenarios involving spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical analysis, quantitative chemical analysis, environmental testing, pharmaceutical analysis, and analytical method development.
  • Assess advanced analytical techniques: Challenge AI models on mass spectrometry, high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), gas chromatography (GC), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) interpretation, trace analysis, titrimetric methods, and related instrumentation.
  • Identify and document model weaknesses: Record reproducible errors, reasoning gaps, inaccurate interpretations, and other failure patterns to support systematic improvements in model performance.
  • Contribute to AI training and evaluation: Provide detailed scientific feedback, propose corrections, and recommend improvements to prompts, evaluation criteria, and testing methodologies.
  • Support scientific quality assurance: Apply principles of method validation, quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC), and analytical data interpretation to evaluate the reliability of AI-generated outputs.
  • Communicate scientific reasoning clearly: Explain conclusions, demonstrate analytical approaches, and document the steps behind technical judgments to help improve model transparency and reliability.

About Kairos

Kairos is a nonprofit accelerating talent into AI safety and policy. In just over two years, we’ve trained 1,200+ people through our flagship programs:

title: AI Trainers Network - Arabic

title: Data Scientist
description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

We're looking for an experienced Data Scientist to join our team. You'll work on projects across the business, from building credit scoring models and improving fraud detection to optimizing field visit schedules and designing A/B tests for targeted user promotions.

In this role, you'll partner with product managers and business leaders to understand the problems they're trying to solve and find practical ways to use data to improve outcomes. Our ideal candidate is product-minded, scrappy and thinks about data in terms of intuitive user behaviours rather than just inputs to a black box model.

In this role you'll;

  • Be embedded closely with our product and operations teams.
  • Generate insights using customer, merchant and internal data using statistical modelling, data visualization, and machine learning.
  • Design, implement and analyze optimizations for our internal operations, user promos, and agent network to help teams scale and reduce costs.
  • Build data-driven heuristics and machine-learning models to improve user and business outcomes.
  • Take ownership of the analytics process - from project scoping and design to communicating findings to stakeholders.

title: Legal Operations and Contracts Manager
description:
About XBOW:

XBOW uses AI to automate offensive security testing, helping organisations identify and address vulnerabilities before attackers exploit them. Working at the intersection of AI and cybersecurity, we’re tackling complex technical challenges and bringing a new approach to security.

As we grow, we’re looking for a Legal Operations & Contracts Manager to help build a legal function that supports our ambition and keeps pace with the business.

About the role:

You’ll sit at the heart of XBOW’s legal team and how it works with the wider business. Combining substantial paralegal experience with legal operations expertise, you’ll own day-to-day legal workflows, support commercial contracting and build the processes that help the team scale.

Working closely with colleagues across Sales, Finance, Product, Engineering, Security and People, you’ll make it easy to engage with Legal, keep matters moving and ensure the team has clear visibility of its priorities.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both detailed legal work and operational ownership. You’ll be comfortable working independently, exercising sound judgement and creating structure in a fast-moving environment.

What you’ll do:

Keep Legal connected to the business

  • Be a central point of contact for legal requests, gathering relevant information, coordinating priorities with legal counsel and tracking matters through to completion.

  • Build strong relationships across XBOW, helping colleagues understand legal processes, approval requirements and next steps.

  • Work closely with Sales and Finance to progress commercial agreements and resolve operational bottlenecks.

  • Give stakeholders clear updates on timelines, dependencies and outstanding decisions.


Support commercial contracting

  • Draft, review and negotiate NDAs, and other lower-risk commercial agreements within agreed playbooks and delegated authority.

  • Support customer contracting by preparing approved templates and order forms, coordinating internal reviews and managing approvals and signatures.

  • Identify non-standard terms and escalate issues requiring legal counsel’s judgement, including those relating to liability,

title: Senior Payroll and Benefits Specialist
description:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Payroll and Benefits Specialist to own payroll processing and compliance for our workforce across the US and Europe. You will be the main contact between the company and our US EOR provider and international payroll advisors (UK, US, Poland, Portugal, Estonia, Germany). For European entities that run payroll locally, you will receive their payroll data, keep one accurate record of who sits on which entity's books, and consolidate it into group-level reporting. You will also own benefits administration, the annual renewal cycle, and pensions in every country where we operate.

The job covers more than processing. You will run live payroll cycles accurately and also improve how payroll works: writing SOPs, tightening controls, consolidating reporting, managing providers, and supporting audits. Over time you will reduce our reliance on third-party providers by moving payroll onto our in-house platform in each country where we hold a local entity, including setting up payroll for a separate US entity on its own system ahead of a planned handover to local ownership. You will work closely with People, Finance, payroll providers, benefits brokers, pension providers, and auditors, and you will be the person employees go to for fast, accurate answers on pay, pension, and benefits. The role is UK-based.

Responsibilities

  • Run UK and US payroll cycles from start to finish: validate all inputs (new hires, leavers, salary changes, bonuses, commissions, time off), review every payroll register, and coordinate with the US EOR and international payroll advisors.

  • Act as the main contact for European entities that run their own payroll: receive monthly payroll data, reconcile it against HRIS headcount, and keep a single accurate record of who sits on which entity's books.

  • Own statutory filings and tax portal access for UK and US payroll, and produce consolidated group payroll reporting to support month-end close, accruals, reconciliations, and audit.

title: Senior ML Engineer
description:
Who we are

Yubo is the Social Discovery app to make new friends and hang out online. By eliminating likes and follows, we empower our users to create genuine connections and show up as their true selves.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow.

Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role

As Yubo continues to scale, Machine Learning is becoming a core production layer, powering critical systems across safety, recommendations, and product optimization.

What makes this role unique is both the scale and diversity of our data, and the level of maturity we are aiming to reach.

We process massive volumes of images, text, and real-time user interactions, across millions of users worldwide, creating a wide range of high-impact ML challenges, including:

  • Content moderation (image, text, behavior)

  • Recommendation systems and user engagement optimization

  • Behavioral detection and trust & safety models

  • Emerging use cases such as dynamic pricing and growth optimization

At the same time, our current ML stack is still evolving.
Legacy models are not fully integrated into pipelines, lifecycle management remains inconsistent, and our approach can sometimes resemble “develop, deploy, and forget.”

As ML usage expands across the company, this creates increasing complexity and dependency on reliable, well-structured systems.

There is still a huge amount of untapped potential, with many ML use cases yet to be designed, tested, and scaled, but unlocking it requires building a more robust and scalable ML operating model.

We are therefore looking for a Senior ML Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team, reporting directly to Mikael (Head of Platform Engineering).

title: Technicien de maintenance Itinérant (F/H)
description:
Notre entreprise Signode, spécialiste de l'emballage et du conditionnement, est à la recherche de son ou sa futur(e) collaborateur (trice) au poste de Technicien(ne) de maintenance SAV itinérant. Notre entreprise offre un environnement dans lequel vous pourrez développer vos compétences avec des évolutions possibles grâce à notre gamme de machines très complète.

Si vous êtes un passionné de maintenance et aimez travailler dans un environnement varié, n'hésitez pas à postuler.

Secteur d'intervention :

·       Le 1/4 Grand Ouest / Nord de la France principalement, et France

·       Prévoir des découchages 3 à 4 nuits / semaine

Objectifs principaux

·       Réparations, installations de machines et gestion des pièces détachées

·       Mise en route d’équipement simple et/ou complexe

·       Gestion des moyens liés au poste (véhicule, outillage…)

·       Etablissement des comptes rendus d’interventions

·       Savoir détecter un besoin/une intervention à prévoir afin de déclencher l’établissement d’un devis<

title: Senior Applied Scientist, Efficient LLM Inference & Model Optimization
AI Trainers Network - Arabic
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Trainers Network – Arabic based in Switzerland.

Join a global network of language professionals and culturally aware contributors helping shape the future of artificial intelligence.
In this flexible, remote opportunity, you can contribute to projects that improve the accuracy, relevance, and inclusivity of AI systems.
Depending on your skills and availability, you may work on text, image, or audio annotation, content evaluation, and prompt creation.
Your Arabic language expertise and cultural understanding will help make AI-generated content more natural, reliable, and representative of diverse communities.
Projects vary in scope and duration, offering opportunities to gain experience with emerging AI technologies while working on your own terms.
This is a talent network opportunity rather than an active job opening, meaning you will be contacted when a suitable project becomes available.
Before each project begins, you will receive clear information about the tasks, timeline, and compensation so you can decide whether it fits your interests and availability.


Accountabilities

As a contributor to the AI Trainers Network, you will support projects designed to improve AI performance, language understanding, and content quality. Depending on the project requirements and your areas of expertise, your responsibilities may include:

  • Annotating and labeling text, images, or audio to help train and improve AI models.

  • Evaluating search results, advertisements, and chatbot responses for accuracy, relevance, quality, and usefulness.

  • Creating, testing, and refining prompts to improve the performance of large language models (LLMs).

  • Reviewing AI-generated content to ensure linguistic accuracy, natural Arabic expression, and cultural appropriateness.

  • Identifying errors, inconsistencies, and potentially misleading or unsuitable content in AI outputs.

  • Applying project-specific guidelines and quality standards while maintaining consistency and attention to detail.

  • Contributing feedback that helps develop safer, more inclusive, and human-centered AI systems.

  • Managing assigned tasks independently and meeting project deadlines according to agreed requirements and availability.

    • Requirements

    We are looking for detail-oriented, curious, and adaptable contributors who are interested in language, technology, and the development of AI systems. The ideal candidate combines strong Arabic language skills with the ability to evaluate information critically and work independently in a digital environment.

title: Content Lead
description:
At Duna, we see the company as the second product we’re building and are continually working to create a transparent, ambitious culture. We want this to be the place where you do your best work.

Our mission is to redefine identity for the global economy. We’re backed by world-class investors including Index Ventures as well as founders and executives from companies like Stripe, Adyen, Notion, Remote, Qonto, Framer, Anthropic, Mollie, OpenAI, Goldman Sachs.

Duna is growing fast, and we're really excited to bring a Head of Content onboard to help shape our voice.

"At a period when most content sounds the same because of AI, compelling content and tone of voice is an even more important differentiator. ." — Duco, Co-founder

Since your role will rarely fit a job description, we only wrote a crisp overview.

What you'll be doing in this role

  • Founder-led content: own our founders' LinkedIn presence. Turn their thinking, customer conversations, and opinions into posts that sound unmistakably like them and get read by the people we sell to

  • Social media content: own LinkedIn content and regular posting of Duna

  • Long-form content: write blogs, white papers, case studies

  • Brand voice: guard our tone of voice across everything we publish, from the website to press releases

What we're looking for

  • 3-8 years of experience - this doesn't necessarily have to be as a content writer. We look for someone who demonstrates clear talent or passion for great copy — this can also be outside of your work

  • Exceptional writing talent — we don't want to sound like a mediocre AI prompt filled with lofty words

  • You can write in someone else's voice. Ghostwriting for an executive, running a founder's LinkedIn, or comparable proof that you can disappear into another person's way of thinking

  • Self-directed: you'll work directly with the founders, and they won't hand you briefs. You extract the raw material yourself
